skills.name: Demolitionist
skills.cue: Use explosives in a fight, under a time limit, or to change a battlefield.
skills.scaling: Explosives you set or throw deal +1 damage die per 5 SL, and their save DC increases by +1 per 5 SL.

ms.name: Handler.
ms.text: You are proficient with explosives and alchemist's supplies. You never set off an explosive by accident. You can set a fuse to go off at the start or end of any turn within the next minute.

ms.name: Bomb Maker.
ms.text: During a short rest, you can make explosives from dungeon scrap, up to your PB per long rest. Each one fills a 10-foot radius: Dexterity save (Skill DC), 2d6 fire damage, half on success. You have advantage on saves against explosions.

ms.name: Shaped Charge.
ms.text: When you set or throw an explosive, you can make its area a 30-foot cone or a 60-foot line instead. Choose up to PB creatures in the area. They automatically succeed on the save and take no damage.

ms.name: Big Boom.
ms.text: Once per long rest, an explosive you set or throw deals maximum damage, and its area is doubled.

ms.name: Extinction Event.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Your explosives deal double damage to creatures, and you are immune to damage from your own explosives. Big Boom recharges on a short rest.

skills.name: Iron Fist
skills.cue: Win or turn a dangerous fight with your bare hands.
skills.scaling: Unarmed strike damage die: d6 (SL 1–4), d8 (SL 5–9), d10 (SL 10–14), d12 (SL 15).

ms.name: Brawler.
ms.text: When you take the Attack action, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action.

ms.name: Hardened Knuckles.
ms.text: Your unarmed strikes count as magical.

ms.name: Knockout.
ms.text: When you score a critical hit with an unarmed strike, the target must succeed on a Constitution save (Skill DC) or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

ms.name: Unstoppable.
ms.text: Your unarmed strikes ignore resistance to bludgeoning damage.

ms.name: One-Inch Punch.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Your unarmed strikes ignore all resistance and immunity to bludgeoning damage. Once per turn, a hit can push the target up to 30 feet; if it hits a wall or creature, both take 2d10 extra bludgeoning damage.

skills.name: Powerful Strike
skills.cue: Land a Powerful Strike that drops or seriously hurts a strong enemy.
skills.scaling: Extra damage is 1d8 per 3 SL, rounded up (1d8 at SL 1, 5d8 at SL 15).

ms.name: Heavy Hit.
ms.text: PB times per long rest, when you hit with a melee attack, add the extra damage (same type as the weapon).

ms.name: Knockback.
ms.text: A Large or smaller target hit by a Powerful Strike is pushed 10 feet away from you.

ms.name: Second Wind.
ms.text: When you roll initiative with no uses left, you regain one use.

ms.name: Relentless.
ms.text: Your uses return when you finish a short or long rest.

ms.name: Earthsplitter.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Powerful Strike has no use limit. Once per turn when you use it, every creature of your choice within 10 feet of the target takes half the extra damage.

skills.name: Pitcher's Arm
skills.cue: Hit an important target with a thrown object at long range or under pressure.
skills.scaling: Thrown weapon attacks deal +1 damage per 2 SL, rounded down.

ms.name: Good Arm.
ms.text: You are proficient with thrown improvised weapons. Your thrown weapons' normal and long ranges are doubled. You can draw a thrown weapon from your inventory as part of the attack.

ms.name: Ricochet.
ms.text: Once per turn, when you hit with a thrown weapon, you can make one more thrown attack, at disadvantage, against a different target within 15 feet of the first.

ms.name: Trick Shot.
ms.text: Your thrown attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover.

ms.name: Bank Shot.
ms.text: Ricochet attacks no longer have disadvantage, and you can ricochet twice per turn.

ms.name: Fastball.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Your thrown weapons' range is 300 feet with no long range. You can throw one extra weapon each time you take the Attack action, and thrown explosives can ricochet too.

skills.name: Weapon Specialist
skills.cue: Win or turn a dangerous fight with that weapon type.
skills.scaling: Attacks with that weapon type deal +1 damage per 3 SL, rounded down.
skills.intro: You choose one weapon type when you gain this Crawler Skill (for example: longsword, crossbow, frying pan). You can gain it more than once, choosing a different type each time.

ms.name: Familiar Grip.
ms.text: You are proficient with that weapon type, and gain +1 to attack rolls with it.

ms.name: Second Nature.
ms.text: You can draw or stow the weapon as part of an attack with it.

ms.name: Precise.
ms.text: Your attacks with that weapon type score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

ms.name: Master.
ms.text: Critical hits on 18–20. The attack bonus becomes +2.

ms.name: Living Weapon.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Critical hits with your chosen weapon type on 17–20. Your weapon of that type counts as magical, can't be disarmed, and returns to your hand as a free action.

skills.name: Dirty Fighting
skills.cue: Win an exchange with a cheap trick: a trip, a shove, sand in the eyes.
skills.scaling: Add half SL (rounded down) to checks to shove.

ms.name: Cheap Shot.
ms.text: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can also try to shove it or knock it prone, without using an action.

ms.name: Riposte.
ms.text: When a creature within 5 feet misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to make one melee attack against it.

ms.name: Stay Down.
ms.text: A creature you knock prone cannot stand up until the end of its next turn.

ms.name: Pocket Sand.
ms.text: When you use Cheap Shot, the target must also succeed on a Constitution save (Skill DC) or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

ms.name: No Rules.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Cheap Shot and Pocket Sand work on every hit, not once per turn. Creatures you knock prone also lose their reaction until the end of their next turn.

skills.name: Bodyguard
skills.cue: Protect an ally from an attack that would have hurt them badly.
skills.scaling: Bodyguard range is 5 feet + 5 feet per 5 SL.

ms.name: Watch Out.
ms.text: When a creature you can see attacks an ally within range, you can use your reaction to give the attack disadvantage.

ms.name: Take the Hit.
ms.text: You can instead use your reaction to become the target of that attack, if the attacker can reach you.

ms.name: Braced.
ms.text: You have resistance to damage from attacks you redirect.

ms.name: Wall.
ms.text: Once per round, you can use Watch Out or Take the Hit without using your reaction.

ms.name: Immovable Object.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. You have resistance to all damage while an ally is within your Bodyguard range. Damage you take for an ally is halved before resistance.

skills.name: Dead Eye
skills.cue: Make a ranged shot that decides a fight.
skills.scaling: Ranged weapon attacks deal +1 damage per 3 SL, rounded down.

ms.name: Steady Aim.
ms.text: As a bonus action, if you have not moved this turn, you gain advantage on your next ranged attack this turn. Your speed becomes 0 until the end of the turn.

ms.name: Long Shot.
ms.text: Attacking at long range does not give you disadvantage on ranged weapon attacks.

ms.name: Weak Spot.
ms.text: Your ranged weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

ms.name: Called Shot.
ms.text: When you hit with an attack that used Steady Aim, the target must succeed on a Constitution save (Skill DC) or suffer one effect of your choice until the end of its next turn: blinded, deafened, or speed 0.

ms.name: Thousand-Yard Stare.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Steady Aim works even if you moved. Ranged attacks you make with advantage score a critical hit on 18–20, and Called Shot can impose two effects at once.

skills.name: Two-Fisted
skills.cue: Win or turn a fight with a weapon in each hand.
skills.scaling: Your off-hand attacks deal +1 damage per 3 SL, rounded down.

ms.name: Dual Grip.
ms.text: You add your ability modifier to the damage of your off-hand attack. You can two-weapon fight with any one-handed melee weapons, including improvised weapons.

ms.name: Guard Hands.
ms.text: You gain +1 AC while you hold a melee weapon in each hand.

ms.name: Cross Cut.
ms.text: When your Attack action and your off-hand attack both hit the same target in one turn, it takes extra damage equal to your SL.

ms.name: Blender.
ms.text: When you make an off-hand attack, you can make two off-hand attacks instead of one.

ms.name: Whirlwind.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Once per turn, as part of your Attack action, you can make one attack with each weapon against every creature within your reach.

skills.name: Wrestler
skills.cue: Grapple something that should not be grappled.
skills.scaling: Add half SL (rounded down) to checks to grapple and to keep a grapple.

ms.name: Clinch.
ms.text: You can grapple creatures up to two sizes larger than you. You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling.

ms.name: Suplex.
ms.text: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one attack with a slam against a creature you are grappling. It takes 1d8 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage and falls prone. The grapple continues.

ms.name: Pin.
ms.text: A creature you are grappling is also restrained.

ms.name: Piledriver.
ms.text: Your slam deals 3d8 + your Strength modifier damage. The target must also succeed on a Constitution save (Skill DC) or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

ms.name: Final Fall.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. You can grapple a creature of any size. Your slam deals 5d8 + your Strength modifier damage, and you can slam two grappled creatures into each other for the same damage to both.

skills.name: Backstab
skills.cue: Strike an enemy who never saw you coming.
skills.scaling: When you hit a creature that is surprised or cannot see you, deal +1d6 per 3 SL (rounded up) extra damage, once per turn. This stacks with Sneak Attack.

ms.name: First Strike.
ms.text: You have advantage on attack rolls against creatures that have not taken a turn yet in this combat.

ms.name: Fade.
ms.text: You can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

ms.name: Twist the Knife.
ms.text: Any hit you score against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

ms.name: Silent Kill.
ms.text: Once per long rest, when you hit a creature that cannot see you, and it has SL × 10 hit points or fewer after the damage, it drops to 0 hit points. Bosses are immune.

ms.name: Death by a Thousand Cuts.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Silent Kill works on any creature that is not a boss, recharges on a short rest, and against a boss deals 10d10 extra damage instead.

skills.name: Bloodlust
skills.cue: Keep fighting, and win, while badly hurt.
skills.scaling: While you are below half your hit points, your melee attacks deal +1 damage per 3 SL (rounded down, minimum 1).

ms.name: Blood Up.
ms.text: While you are below half your hit points, you have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saves.

ms.name: Bloodthirst.
ms.text: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, you gain temporary hit points equal to SL + your Constitution modifier.

ms.name: Red Mist.
ms.text: While you are below half your hit points, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

ms.name: Refuse to Fall.
ms.text: Once per long rest, when you drop to 0 hit points and do not die outright, you drop to SL × 2 hit points instead.

ms.name: Berserker God.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. While below half your hit points, you can make one extra attack whenever you take the Attack action, and you regain hit points equal to half the damage you deal with melee attacks.

skills.name: Bomb Surgeon
skills.cue: Disarm, rewire or rebuild an explosive while it is dangerous.
skills.scaling: Add half SL (rounded down) to checks to disarm or modify explosives and mechanical traps.

ms.name: Steady Hands.
ms.text: You have advantage on checks to disarm explosives. When you Inspect an explosive, you learn its damage, area and trigger.

ms.name: Rewire.
ms.text: As an action, you can change the trigger of an explosive or explosive trap you can touch: timer, pressure plate, tripwire, or a spoken word.

ms.name: Frankenbomb.
ms.text: During a short rest, you can combine two explosives into one. Add their damage dice together (maximum total dice equal to your SL). Its area is the larger area + 5 feet.

ms.name: Defuse Anything.
ms.text: When an explosive within 30 feet of you is about to go off, you can use your reaction to make an Intelligence check against its save DC. On a success, it does not go off. You can do this PB times per long rest. Boss and System explosives are immune.

ms.name: Bomb Whisperer.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Defuse Anything has no use limit, and works on boss and System explosives. When you defuse one, you can store it in your inventory, ready to use.

skills.name: Gunslinger
skills.cue: Win or turn a fight with a firearm.
skills.scaling: Firearm attacks deal +1 damage per 3 SL, rounded down.

ms.name: Trigger Discipline.
ms.text: You are proficient with firearms (see Firearms). Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature does not give you disadvantage on attacks with pistols.

ms.name: Speed Reload.
ms.text: You can reload a firearm as a bonus action. You can clear a misfire as a bonus action.

ms.name: Dead Shot.
ms.text: Your firearm attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

ms.name: Fan the Hammer.
ms.text: Once per turn, when you take the Attack action with a pistol or revolver, you can make one extra attack with it.

ms.name: Bullet Time.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Once per long rest, for 1 minute, you make two extra firearm attacks whenever you take the Attack action, and your firearms never misfire or need reloading.

skills.name: Tough as Nails
skills.cue: Survive a fight in which you drop below a quarter of your hit points.
skills.scaling: Your hit point maximum increases by 1 per character level (SL 1–4), 2 (SL 5–9), or 3 (SL 10–15).

ms.name: Thick Skin.
ms.text: Scaling only.

ms.name: Endurance.
ms.text: You have advantage on saves against exhaustion.

ms.name: Shrug It Off.
ms.text: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to reduce it by your Constitution modifier + SL. You can do this PB times per long rest.

ms.name: Unbreakable.
ms.text: Once per long rest, when you take damage, you can take none instead.

ms.name: Invincible.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Unbreakable recharges on a short rest. While you have at least 1 hit point, you cannot be reduced below 1 hit point by a single hit.

skills.name: Cockroach
skills.cue: Come back from 0 hit points.
skills.scaling: When you regain hit points while at 0, you regain SL extra hit points.

ms.name: Still Kicking.
ms.text: You have advantage on death saving throws.

ms.name: Get Up.
ms.text: When you are stabilized, you regain 1 hit point and can stand up using 5 feet of movement.

ms.name: Not Today.
ms.text: Once per long rest, when you fail a death saving throw, you succeed instead and regain hit points equal to your character level.

ms.name: Unkillable.
ms.text: You can use Not Today PB times per long rest.

ms.name: Can't Stay Dead.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Once per floor, when you die, you return to life at the start of your next turn with hit points equal to your level, unless your body was destroyed.

skills.name: Escape Artist
skills.cue: Escape a grab, trap, restraint, or a fight you should not be in.
skills.scaling: Add half SL (rounded down) to checks and saves to escape grapples and restraints.

ms.name: Slippery.
ms.text: You have advantage on checks and saves to escape grapples and restraints. Nonmagical restraints cannot hold you for more than 1 minute.

ms.name: Footwork.
ms.text: Difficult terrain does not slow you. Opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.

ms.name: Blink.
ms.text: Once per long rest, when you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to teleport up to 30 feet to a space you can see. The attack misses.

ms.name: Gone.
ms.text: You can use Blink PB times per long rest.

ms.name: Houdini.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. You cannot be grappled or restrained unless you allow it. Blink no longer uses your reaction, and the attack misses everyone nearby, not only you.

skills.name: Iron Stomach
skills.cue: Eat, drink or breathe something that should have hurt you.
skills.scaling: Add half SL (rounded down) to saves against poison and disease.

ms.name: Strong Gut.
ms.text: You have advantage on saves against poison and disease. You can safely eat anything that is not actively poisonous.

ms.name: Toxin Tolerance.
ms.text: You have resistance to poison damage.

ms.name: Purge.
ms.text: You cannot be poisoned.

ms.name: Immune.
ms.text: You are immune to poison damage. You can drink a potion as a bonus action.

ms.name: Bottomless.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. You are immune to disease and the poisoned condition, and you can drink any potion as a free action. Potions you drink have twice their normal effect.

skills.name: Night Eyes
skills.cue: Spot something important in darkness or bad visibility.
skills.scaling: You have darkvision to 50 feet + 10 feet per SL (60 feet at SL 1). If you already have darkvision, use whichever is longer, +30 feet.

ms.name: Low Light.
ms.text: Scaling only.

ms.name: Fog Sight.
ms.text: Smoke, fog and dust do not obscure your vision within 30 feet.

ms.name: Void Sight.
ms.text: You can see normally in magical darkness within 30 feet.

ms.name: True Eyes.
ms.text: You have truesight to 30 feet.

ms.name: All-Seeing.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Your truesight range becomes 120 feet, and you can see through walls up to 5 feet thick.

skills.name: Trap Sense
skills.cue: Find, avoid or disarm a dangerous trap.
skills.scaling: Add half SL (rounded down) to checks to find and disarm traps.

ms.name: Wary.
ms.text: You have advantage on checks to find and disarm traps. You remember every trap you have found, and never set off one of them by accident.

ms.name: Flinch.
ms.text: You have advantage on saves against traps, and resistance to damage from traps.

ms.name: Sixth Sense.
ms.text: You automatically notice any trap within 10 feet of you.

ms.name: Redirect.
ms.text: Sixth Sense range becomes 30 feet. When you trigger a trap, you can use your reaction to choose a different target in its area.

ms.name: Trap Lord.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Sixth Sense range becomes 60 feet. Traps never affect you, and you can rearm any trap you find to work for you.

skills.name: First Aid
skills.cue: Keep an ally alive in a fight or a crisis.
skills.scaling: Healing you give with a healer's kit or a potion restores +SL extra hit points.

ms.name: Patch Up.
ms.text: You are proficient with healer's kits. As an action, you can spend one use of a healer's kit to restore 1d6 + SL hit points to a creature. Each creature can benefit once per short rest. You can stabilize a creature as a bonus action.

ms.name: Field Medic.
ms.text: You can give a potion to another creature within 5 feet as a bonus action.

ms.name: Surgeon.
ms.text: During a short rest, you can end one disease or the poisoned condition, or remove one level of exhaustion, for up to PB creatures.

ms.name: Not on My Watch.
ms.text: Once per long rest, when an ally within 30 feet would die, you can use your reaction to make it stable at 0 hit points instead. This does not work against effects that leave no body.

ms.name: Miracle Medic.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Not on My Watch recharges on a short rest. Your Patch Up restores 5d6 + SL hit points and can be used as a bonus action.

skills.name: Parkour
skills.cue: Cross dangerous ground, or escape, by climbing, jumping or sliding.
skills.scaling: Your long and high jump distances increase by 1 foot per SL.

ms.name: Free Runner.
ms.text: You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed. You can make running jumps without a run-up.

ms.name: Wall Run.
ms.text: You can move along vertical surfaces for up to half your speed in a turn. You fall if you end your turn on one.

ms.name: Roll With It.
ms.text: When you fall, you can use your reaction to reduce the falling damage by 5 × SL. You land on your feet.

ms.name: Untouchable Line.
ms.text: When you Dash, you can move through hostile creatures' spaces, and you do not provoke opportunity attacks.

ms.name: Gravity Optional.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. You can move along walls and ceilings for your whole turn without falling, and you take no falling damage.

skills.name: Sneak
skills.cue: Get past serious danger without being seen.
skills.scaling: Add half SL (rounded down) to Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

ms.name: Quiet Feet.
ms.text: You can move at full speed without a penalty to Stealth.

ms.name: Blend In.
ms.text: You can try to hide when you are only lightly obscured, or in a crowd of creatures your size or larger.

ms.name: Ghost.
ms.text: If you are hidden and you miss with an attack, you stay hidden.

ms.name: Not Here.
ms.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you become invisible for 1 minute (concentration). It ends early if you attack or cast a spell.

ms.name: Phantom.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Not Here no longer needs concentration, recharges on a short rest, and does not end when you attack.

skills.name: Forager
skills.cue: Find food, water, or useful material in a hostile place.
skills.scaling: Add half SL (rounded down) to Survival checks to forage, track, and identify plants and monster parts.

ms.name: Live off the Land.
ms.text: Each day, you can find food and water for up to PB creatures, if any exists nearby. You know if a monster part is edible.

ms.name: Harvester.
ms.text: After a fight, you can spend 10 minutes harvesting monster parts. They count as crafting materials for Tinkerer and Alchemy (GM sets the value).

ms.name: Trail Boss.
ms.text: Difficult terrain does not slow your party's travel pace. Your party cannot be surprised while it travels with you.

ms.name: Alchemical Eye.
ms.text: You can learn every property of a plant, potion or monster part by handling it for 1 minute.

ms.name: Dungeon Gourmet.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. When you harvest, every creature gives two extra Monster Parts or Essence. Food you forage counts as a Cooking meal with one Chef's Special.

skills.name: Cooking
skills.cue: Cook a meal for the party in a dangerous place, or with strange dungeon ingredients.
skills.scaling: Each creature that eats your meal gains temporary hit points equal to your character level + SL.

ms.name: Hot Meal.
ms.text: During a short or long rest, you can cook a meal for up to 6 creatures (needs food and heat).

ms.name: Comfort Food.
ms.text: Each creature that eats also has advantage on its next saving throw within 8 hours.

ms.name: Chef's Special.
ms.text: Choose a bonus for the meal, which lasts 8 hours: +10 feet speed, resistance to one damage type, or +1 to attack rolls.

ms.name: Feast.
ms.text: Choose two Chef's Special bonuses. Each creature that eats also removes one level of exhaustion.

ms.name: Five-Star Chef.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Meals give all three Chef's Special bonuses, the temporary hit points are doubled, and each diner regains one spent Hit Die.

skills.name: Lock and Key
skills.cue: Open a lock that matters, under time pressure or danger.
skills.scaling: Add half SL (rounded down) to checks with thieves' tools.

ms.name: Picks.
ms.text: You are proficient with thieves' tools.

ms.name: Quick Hands.
ms.text: You add double your PB to checks with thieves' tools. You can pick a lock as a bonus action.

ms.name: Skeleton Key.
ms.text: Once per long rest, you can open one magical lock or seal without a check. Floor boss and System seals are immune.

ms.name: Master Key.
ms.text: You can use Skeleton Key PB times per long rest.

ms.name: Open Sesame.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Skeleton Key has no use limit, and works on boss seals. You can lock any door or container so only you can open it.

skills.name: Cartographer
skills.cue: Find a route, shortcut, or stairwell under time pressure.
skills.scaling: Travelling through explored areas costs 1 floor turn per 3 areas (normally 2). At SL 10, 1 per 4 areas.

ms.name: Pathfinder.
ms.text: You have advantage on checks to find secret doors, hidden passages and shortcuts. Once per floor, you can ask the GM "Is there a shorter way?" and get a true answer.

ms.name: Read the Signs.
ms.text: When you enter an area, you can ask the GM one question, such as "Is a boss near?", "Has anything big been through here?" or "Is there a safe room within 3 areas?" The GM answers truthfully. Once per area.

ms.name: Stairwell Sense.
ms.text: You always know the direction to the nearest stairwell, and roughly how far it is (near, far, or very far).

ms.name: Survey.
ms.text: When you arrive on a new floor, the GM tells you its neighbourhood themes, roughly where each one is, and where one stairwell is. The GM can hand you a rough sketch instead.

ms.name: Living Atlas.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. When you arrive on a new floor, the GM tells you where every stairwell and safe room is.

skills.name: Pack Rat
skills.cue: Pull the right item out of your inventory at the right moment.
skills.scaling: Your inventory gains 2 slots per SL.

ms.name: Organized.
ms.text: Scaling only.

ms.name: Juggler.
ms.text: You can store or retrieve two items with one free object interaction.

ms.name: Quick Swap.
ms.text: Once per turn, you can swap the item in your hand with one in your inventory, with no action.

ms.name: Pocket Catch.
ms.text: When a nonmagical object or projectile that fits in one slot is thrown or shot at you, you can use your reaction to store it in your inventory. The attack misses.

ms.name: Bag of Everything.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Your inventory gains 50 slots. Once per long rest, you can pull out any mundane item worth 10 gp or less that you do not have.

skills.name: Tinkerer
skills.cue: Repair, build or rig something that gets the party out of trouble.
skills.scaling: Add half SL (rounded down) to checks with tinker's tools.

ms.name: Fixer.
ms.text: You are proficient with tinker's tools. During a short rest, you can use dungeon scrap to repair a broken item, or build a simple trap or tool (GM approval).

ms.name: Salvage.
ms.text: You can break down a common magic item into crafting material. Use it to add a minor property to another item (light, waterproof, returns to your inventory, and so on).

ms.name: Craftsman.
ms.text: In a safe room, you can craft uncommon magic items at half the normal time and cost.

ms.name: Artificer.
ms.text: Craftsman applies to rare magic items too.

ms.name: Mad Inventor.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Craftsman applies to very rare magic items, and you can craft one item per floor at no gold cost (materials still needed).

skills.name: Appraisal
skills.cue: Judge loot, or a deal, correctly when it matters.
skills.scaling: Add half SL (rounded down) to checks to identify items and judge their value.

ms.name: Price Tag.
ms.text: When you Inspect an item, you learn its value, and whether it is magical.

ms.name: Identify.
ms.text: When you Inspect a magic item, you also learn its properties, except curses.

ms.name: Curse Check.
ms.text: Inspect also shows curses, charges and attunement needs.

ms.name: Loot Sense.
ms.text: Once per floor, when you open a loot box, the GM rolls its contents twice and you choose one result.

ms.name: Treasure Hunter.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Loot Sense works on every loot box you open, not once per floor.

skills.name: Haggler
skills.cue: Get a deal from a shopkeeper, NPC or sponsor that should not have happened.
skills.scaling: Shop prices are 2% lower per SL for you. Items you sell earn 2% more per SL.

ms.name: Bargain.
ms.text: You have advantage on Charisma checks to haggle with merchants.

ms.name: Full Price.
ms.text: Safe room shops buy your items at full value, not half.

ms.name: Back Stock.
ms.text: Each shop visit, the shop shows you one extra item from a better loot table.

ms.name: Black Market.
ms.text: Once per floor, you can buy one item of a rarity the shops do not normally sell on this floor.

ms.name: Shopkeeper's Nightmare.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Your discount is 50%, and once per floor you can buy one legendary item from any shop.

skills.name: Pet Trainer
skills.cue: Your pet does something that matters to the fight or the story.
skills.scaling: Your pet's hit point maximum increases by 2 × SL.

ms.name: Companion.
ms.text: Your pet (see the Pets handbook) adds your PB to its AC, attack rolls, damage rolls and saves. You can tame creatures of CR 1/4 or lower.

ms.name: Partner.
ms.text: You can tame and keep pets of CR 1 or lower. You can command your pet to attack as part of your Attack action.

ms.name: Shared Pain.
ms.text: You can tame and keep pets of CR 3 or lower, and its attacks count as magical. When your pet takes damage, you can use your reaction to take that damage instead.

ms.name: Evolution.
ms.text: You can tame and keep pets of CR 5 or lower. Your pet gains one evolution from the Evolutions table in the Pets handbook.

ms.name: Beast King.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. You can tame and keep pets of CR 10 or lower. Your pet gains one more evolution, and attacks twice when commanded to attack.

skills.name: Sticky Fingers
skills.cue: Steal something important while someone is watching.
skills.scaling: Add half SL (rounded down) to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks.

ms.name: Quick Pocket.
ms.text: When you steal an item, you can store it in your inventory as part of the same action.

ms.name: Light Touch.
ms.text: You can make a Sleight of Hand check, or take the Use an Object action, as a bonus action.

ms.name: Snatch.
ms.text: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one attack with a Sleight of Hand check against the target's Athletics or Acrobatics. On a success, you take one one-handed item it is holding and store it in your inventory.

ms.name: Grand Theft.
ms.text: Snatch also works on two-handed items, and on worn items other than armor.

ms.name: Phantom Thief.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Snatch works on armor and on items a creature is holding with both hands. You can Snatch once on every hit.

skills.name: Smooth Talker
skills.cue: Talk your way out of, or into, serious trouble.
skills.scaling: Add half SL (rounded down) to Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Deception) checks.

ms.name: Silver Tongue.
ms.text: Once per long rest, you can reroll a Persuasion or Deception check. Use the new roll.

ms.name: Read the Room.
ms.text: You can make a Wisdom (Insight) check as a bonus action. On a success, you also learn the creature's attitude toward you.

ms.name: Calm Down.
ms.text: As an action, choose a hostile creature within 30 feet that can understand you. It must succeed on a Wisdom save (Skill DC) or not attack you for 1 minute, unless you or your allies harm it. You can do this once per short rest.

ms.name: Deal Maker.
ms.text: Once per long rest, choose a creature that is not a boss and can understand you. It must succeed on a Wisdom save (Skill DC) or be charmed by you for 1 hour.

ms.name: Silver-Tongued Devil.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Deal Maker works on bosses, recharges on a short rest, and lasts 24 hours.

skills.name: Crowd Pleaser
skills.cue: Do something spectacular in front of the cameras.
skills.scaling: None.

ms.name: Showboat.
ms.text: Once per long rest, when you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a critical hit, a stunt, or anything the GM finds entertaining, you gain Inspiration.

ms.name: Share the Spotlight.
ms.text: You can use Showboat twice per long rest. You can give your Inspiration to an ally within 30 feet as a bonus action.

ms.name: Crowd Favorite.
ms.text: When you spend Inspiration, roll two extra d20s and use any one of the three rolls.

ms.name: Superstar.
ms.text: You can use Showboat PB times per long rest.

ms.name: Fan Favorite.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Showboat has no use limit. Whenever you spend Inspiration, every ally within 30 feet also gains advantage on its next d20 roll.

skills.name: Trash Talk
skills.cue: Make a dangerous enemy lose its temper and make a mistake.
skills.scaling: A creature that fails the save takes psychic damage equal to half SL (rounded up).

ms.name: Taunt.
ms.text: As a bonus action, insult a creature within 30 feet that can hear you. It must succeed on a Wisdom save (Skill DC) or have disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you until the end of its next turn.

ms.name: Cutting Words.
ms.text: Add your Charisma modifier to the psychic damage.

ms.name: Heckler.
ms.text: You can target up to two creatures with one Taunt.

ms.name: Tilted.
ms.text: A creature that fails the save also cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn.

ms.name: Roast Battle.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Taunt targets every creature you choose within 30 feet. A creature that fails the save also takes psychic damage equal to your SL.

skills.name: Hype Man
skills.cue: Rally the party when it is losing.
skills.scaling: Pep Talk gives temporary hit points equal to SL + your Charisma modifier.

ms.name: Pep Talk.
ms.text: As a bonus action, choose one ally within 30 feet that can hear you. It gains the temporary hit points. You can do this PB times per long rest.

ms.name: Momentum.
ms.text: The target of Pep Talk also adds 1d4 to its next attack roll or saving throw.

ms.name: Team Spirit.
ms.text: Pep Talk can target up to three allies.

ms.name: Encore.
ms.text: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, every ally within 60 feet ends the charmed and frightened conditions on itself and gains the benefit of Pep Talk.

ms.name: Hype Train.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Pep Talk targets every ally within 60 feet. Encore recharges on a short rest.

skills.name: Dramatic Entrance
skills.cue: Start a fight in a way the audience will remember.
skills.scaling: Add half SL (rounded down) to initiative rolls.

ms.name: Make an Entrance.
ms.text: On your first turn in a combat, your speed increases by 10 feet, and your first hit deals +1d6 damage.

ms.name: Stunned Silence.
ms.text: When you roll initiative, choose one creature that can see you. It must succeed on a Wisdom save (Skill DC) or be unable to take reactions until the end of its first turn.

ms.name: All Eyes on Me.
ms.text: Stunned Silence can target up to PB creatures.

ms.name: Showstopper.
ms.text: You cannot be surprised. On your first turn in a combat, you can take one extra action: Attack, Dash, or Use an Object.

ms.name: Main Character.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Showstopper's extra action can be any action, and you get it on your first two turns of every combat.

skills.name: Mana Well
skills.cue: Run your mana pool to empty in a dangerous fight.
skills.scaling: Your mana pool increases by SL.

ms.name: Reserve.
ms.text: Scaling only.

ms.name: Surge.
ms.text: When you roll initiative, you regain 2 mana.

ms.name: Deep Well.
ms.text: When you finish a short rest, you regain half your mana pool + SL.

ms.name: Overflow.
ms.text: Once per long rest, when you have 0 mana, you can regain half your mana pool as a bonus action.

ms.name: Infinite Reserve.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. When you roll initiative, you regain mana equal to your SL. Overflow recharges on a short rest.

skills.name: Tome Scholar
skills.cue: Learn a new tome, or use a tome spell to solve a problem in a new way.
skills.scaling: None.

ms.name: Speed Reader.
ms.text: You can learn tome spells one spell level higher than your normal limit. You learn a tome in 1 action instead of 1 minute.

ms.name: Efficient.
ms.text: Tome spells cost 1 less mana to cast (minimum 1).

ms.name: Deep Study.
ms.text: When you read a duplicate tome, the spell gains 2 ranks instead of 1.

ms.name: Archmage.
ms.text: You can cast each tome spell of 6th level or higher twice per long rest, not once.

ms.name: Grand Archmage.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Tome spells cost half their normal mana (rounded up). You can cast tome spells of 6th level or higher three times per long rest each.

skills.name: Signature Spell
skills.cue: Cast the chosen spell at a turning point in a fight.
skills.scaling: None.
skills.intro: Choose one tome spell you know when you gain this Crawler Skill. You can gain it more than once, choosing a different spell each time.

ms.name: Favorite.
ms.text: You can cast the spell once per long rest without spending mana.

ms.name: Practiced.
ms.text: You can cast it twice per long rest without spending mana.

ms.name: Perfected.
ms.text: When you cast the spell, you can roll its damage twice and use either total.

ms.name: Instinct.
ms.text: Once per long rest, you can cast the spell as a bonus action, if its casting time is 1 action.

ms.name: Spell of Legend.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Your signature spell costs no mana and can be cast as a bonus action once per round.

skills.name: Alchemy
skills.cue: Brew something that saves the day.
skills.scaling: Healing potions you brew restore +SL extra hit points. The save DC of poisons you brew increases by +1 per 5 SL.

ms.name: Brewer.
ms.text: You are proficient with alchemist's supplies. During a long rest, you can brew one common healing potion from dungeon ingredients.

ms.name: Batch.
ms.text: During a long rest, you can brew up to PB items in any mix: healing potion, antitoxin, alchemist's fire, or basic poison (Constitution save, Skill DC, 2d6 poison damage and poisoned for 1 minute on a failure).

ms.name: Greater Brew.
ms.text: Once per long rest in a safe room, you can brew a greater healing potion, or an uncommon potion you have identified before.

ms.name: Master Alchemist.
ms.text: Once per long rest in a safe room, you can brew a superior healing potion, or a rare potion you have identified before.

ms.name: Philosopher's Stone.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Once per long rest in a safe room, you can brew a very rare potion you have identified before. Potions you brew last twice as long.

skills.name: Mana Shield
skills.cue: Survive a big hit by burning mana.
skills.scaling: Each mana you spend on Barrier prevents 2 damage (3 at SL 5, 4 at SL 10, 5 at SL 15).

ms.name: Barrier.
ms.text: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to spend up to PB mana to reduce the damage.

ms.name: Ward Ally.
ms.text: You can use Barrier when an ally within 30 feet takes damage.

ms.name: Spell Sink.
ms.text: When you succeed on a saving throw against a spell, you regain 2 mana.

ms.name: Aegis.
ms.text: Once per round, you can use Barrier without using your reaction.

ms.name: Arcane Fortress.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Each mana you spend on Barrier prevents 10 damage, and you can spend any amount of mana at once.

skills.name: Spellblade
skills.cue: Mix weapon attacks and tome magic in a fight that matters.
skills.scaling: Charged Strike deals 1d6 force damage, +1d6 per 5 SL.

ms.name: Charged Strike.
ms.text: Once per turn, when you hit with a weapon, you can spend 1 mana to add the force damage.

ms.name: War Caster.
ms.text: You have advantage on Constitution saves to keep concentration on tome spells. You can cast tome spells with your hands full.

ms.name: Blade and Spell.
ms.text: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one attack with a tome cantrip.

ms.name: Arcane Surge.
ms.text: When you cast a tome spell with a casting time of 1 action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

ms.name: Blade Arcana.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Charged Strike costs no mana and can be used on every hit. Blade and Spell can replace any number of attacks with tome cantrips.

skills.name: Quick Cast
skills.cue: Get a spell off at the last possible moment.
skills.scaling: None.

ms.name: Snap.
ms.text: Once per long rest, you can cast a tome cantrip or a 1st-level tome spell with a casting time of 1 action as a bonus action instead.

ms.name: Quick.
ms.text: You can use Snap PB times per long rest, on tome spells of 3rd level or lower.

ms.name: Counter.
ms.text: You know counterspell as a tome spell, without a tome.

ms.name: Double Cast.
ms.text: Once per long rest, as an action, you can cast two tome spells that each have a casting time of 1 action. Pay mana for both. Only one can need concentration.

ms.name: Spell Storm.
ms.text: Limit Breaker only. Double Cast recharges on a short rest, and both spells can need concentration.

spells.name: Fire Flick
ranks: 3d10 fire damage. You can hold the flame in your palm as a torch between casts (bright light 20 feet).
4d10 fire damage. On a hit, the target also burns for 1d10 fire damage at the start of its next turn.
spells.note: Please do not flick fire at the sponsors' banners.
spells.description: You flick a marble of fire at a creature or object. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if no one is wearing or carrying it.

spells.name: Freezer Burn
ranks: 4d8 cold damage. A target whose speed drops to 0 this way is frozen to the floor: it is Restrained until the start of your next turn.
spells.description: A beam of frost the color of a cheap ice pop hits one creature. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed drops by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Joy Buzzer
ranks: 3d8 lightning damage. Range becomes 15 feet: the spark jumps.
4d8 lightning damage. The spark then jumps to a second creature within 10 feet of the first. Make a new attack roll against it.
spells.note: A classic! The audience loves a prank.
spells.description: You shake hands with violence. Make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 lightning damage and can't take reactions until the start of its next turn. You have advantage on the attack if the target wears metal armor.

spells.name: Stank Cloud
ranks: 3d12 poison damage. On a failure, the target also has disadvantage on its next attack roll.
4d12 poison damage. The cloud fills a 5-foot radius around the target. Every creature in it makes the save.
spells.description: You blast a creature with a puff of unspeakable gas. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 1d12 poison damage.

spells.name: Acid Spit
ranks: 3d6 acid damage. The acid also eats through a lock, chain or hinge in the area.
4d6 acid damage. A creature that fails the save also has −2 AC until the start of your next turn.
spells.description: You hock a glob of acid at a point within range. Each creature in a 5-foot radius of that point makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 1d6 acid damage.

spells.name: Grave Chill
ranks: 3d10 necrotic damage. Range becomes 60 feet (a skeletal hand reaches out for you).
4d10 necrotic damage. An undead target also has disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the end of your next turn.
spells.description: The cold of a closed casket. Make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 necrotic damage and can't regain hit points until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Holy Mackerel
ranks: 3d8 radiant damage. The fish leaves the target shining: it can't benefit from being Invisible until the start of your next turn.
4d8 radiant damage. You can target two creatures.
spells.note: Divine intervention, delivered fresh.
spells.description: A glowing, spectral fish slaps a creature you can see. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. It gains no benefit from cover against this save. On a failure, it takes 1d8 radiant damage.

spells.name: Pact Beam
ranks: Two beams. Make a separate attack for each. They can hit the same target or different ones.
Four beams. The first beam that hits on each turn pushes the target 10 feet away from you.
spells.description: Your patron lends you a beam of raw, crackling contract energy. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage.

spells.name: Heckle
ranks: 3d6 psychic damage. The disadvantage applies to its next attack roll or saving throw, whichever comes first.
4d6 psychic damage. If the insult kills the target, gain 1 Audience point (once per floor).
spells.note: Heckling is a protected art form in the World Dungeon. Unlike you.
spells.description: You say something so cutting it hurts. One creature that can hear you makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes 1d6 psychic damage and has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

spells.name: Torch
spells.allowed_classes: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard
ranks: The light can float instead, following 5 feet from you.
Up to three lights at once, each on an object or floating within 60 feet of you. You can move them as a bonus action.
You can choose the color. Sunlight color counts as sunlight for creatures that hate it.
As a bonus action, flare one light. Each creature within 10 feet of it makes a Constitution saving throw or is Blinded until the end of its next turn. The light then goes out.
spells.description: You touch an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. It sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for a further 20 feet. You can end the light as a bonus action.

spells.name: Grabby Hand
ranks: The hand can carry 25 pounds and move 60 feet.
You control the hand as a bonus action instead of an action.
The hand can make Sleight of Hand checks for you, using your bonus.
The hand can slap: a creature within 5 feet of it makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage (once per turn).
spells.description: A floating cartoon glove appears. As a Magic action you can use it to handle an object, open a door or container, or pour something out. It can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

spells.name: Party Trick
spells.allowed_classes: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard
ranks: Up to two effects at a time.
Up to three effects at a time. You have advantage on Performance checks you make while one is active.
You can change the weather for 1 minute in a 30-foot radius (a light drizzle, a breeze, a small spotlight).
Once per long rest, a party trick earns a cheap viewer reaction. Make a Performance check with advantage to impress a crowd or distract a mob.
spells.description: A small, harmless bit of magic for the cameras. Choose one: clean or soil a small object; chill, warm or flavor food; make a small mark or symbol appear for an hour; make your voice boom three times louder; make flames flicker or change color; make a harmless sensory effect (a smell, a sound, a puff of wind, a flower blooming); or make the ground tremble harmlessly.

spells.name: Cardboard Cutout
ranks: A sound and an image at once, in the same place.
The image can be up to a 10-foot cube and can move up to 30 feet each turn as you direct it (no action).
Creatures have disadvantage on the check to see through it.
The illusion lasts 1 hour, and touching it no longer reveals it unless the creature also succeeds on the Investigation check.
spells.description: You make a sound or a still image of an object (no larger than a 5-foot cube) in range. A creature that studies it can see through it with an Investigation check against your spell save DC. Physical contact reveals an image as fake.

spells.name: Pep Talk
ranks: The die can be added to an ability check or a saving throw.
You can cast it as a bonus action, and it no longer needs concentration.
spells.description: "You've got this, champ." One willing creature can add 1d4 to one ability check of its choice before the spell ends.

spells.name: Duct Tape
ranks: Breaks up to 5 feet, and broken weapons or armor (one item per short rest).
You can restore 2d8 hit points to a construct or object.
You can repair a broken magic item, if all its pieces are present (once per long rest).
spells.note: Holds the dungeon together. Literally. Don't look at the ceiling.
spells.description: Shimmering gray tape mends a single break or tear in an object: a broken chain, a torn cloak, a cracked bottle. The break can be no larger than 1 foot in any dimension.

spells.name: Sponsor Smile
ranks: Advantage on Charisma checks against one creature.
The creature doesn't realize it was charmed when the spell ends.
Shopkeepers affected give you a 10% discount (once per shop visit).
spells.description: You flash the smile of someone with a brand deal. One creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, you have advantage on Charisma checks against it until the spell ends. A creature that succeeds can't be affected by this spell again for 24 hours. A creature that fails knows it was charmed once the spell ends.

spells.name: Whisper Network
ranks: Up to three creatures, who can all hear each other.
Duration becomes 10 minutes: a whispered party chat.
Range becomes 1 mile, as long as the targets are on the same floor.
spells.description: You whisper a message to a creature in range. Only it hears the message, and it can whisper back. The spell goes around corners if you are familiar with the target.

spells.name: Weapon Hype
spells.allowed_classes: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard
ranks: Use your spellcasting ability; damage die at least d8.
Your first hit with it on each turn deals an extra 1d6 force damage.
The extra damage becomes 2d6 force. Damage die at least d10.
The extra damage becomes 3d6 force. The weapon glows with your sponsor's logo, and its damage die becomes a d12.
spells.note: Ask about our weapon sponsorship packages.
spells.description: You hype up the weapon you're holding (a stick counts). For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength or Dexterity for its attack and damage rolls, and its damage counts as magical. Its damage die becomes a d8 if it was smaller.

spells.name: Not Today
ranks: You can cast it as a bonus action.
The target also regains 1d4 hit points.
spells.description: "Absolutely not." A creature at 0 hit points becomes Stable.

spells.name: Vine Yank
ranks: 3d6 piercing damage. You can pull it up to 20 feet.
4d6 piercing damage. If you pull the target next to you, it also has the Prone condition.
spells.description: A thorny vine whips out of the floor tiles. Make a melee spell attack against a creature in range. On a hit, it takes 1d6 piercing damage, and if it is Large or smaller, you pull it up to 10 feet closer to you.

spells.name: Flinch
ranks: You can protect one other creature within 10 feet of you instead of yourself.
When an attack misses you because of this spell, you can move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks (no action).
spells.description: You go full cartoon wince. Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you before the spell ends, the attacker subtracts 1d4 from the roll.

spells.name: Magic Missile
ranks: Five darts. The darts bend around corners and full cover, as long as you know where the target is.
spells.note: A classic. A favorite of cats everywhere. We can't imagine why.
spells.description: Glowing darts of force streak from your fingers. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range, and deals 1d4 + 1 force damage. You can split the darts however you like. They never miss.

spells.name: Mystery Box
ranks: 3d8 damage, random type, bounces on doubles.
5d8 damage. You can reroll the type die once.
7d8 damage. You choose the type instead of rolling.
spells.note: What's in the box? Pain. It's always pain.
spells.description: You hurl a gift-wrapped sphere of energy. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 3d8 damage. Roll a d6 for the type: 1 acid, 2 cold, 3 fire, 4 lightning, 5 poison, 6 thunder. If two or more of the damage dice roll the same number, the box bounces to another creature within 30 feet of the target: make a new attack roll against it. Each creature can be hit only once per casting.

spells.name: Flamethrower
ranks: 7d6 fire damage. You can keep it going: as a bonus action on your next turn, breathe the cone again for half the damage (no mana).
spells.description: Fire roars from your hands. Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 3d6 fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Flammable objects in the cone that no one is wearing or carrying start burning.

spells.name: Sonic Boom
ranks: 4d8 thunder damage. Push 20 feet, and creatures pushed into a wall have the Prone condition.
6d8 thunder damage. You choose which creatures in the cube are affected.
spells.description: A wave of bass explodes out of you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 2d8 thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a success, it takes half as much damage and isn't pushed. The boom is audible 300 feet away.

spells.name: Nope
ranks: +5 AC until the start of your next turn.
You can also use it when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage: you have resistance to that damage until the start of your next turn.
The first attack that misses you because of this spell takes 1d8 force damage back.
You can cast it on an ally within 30 feet instead of yourself.
spells.note: Nope. A complete sentence, and a complete spell.
spells.casting_time: 1 reaction, when you are hit by an attack or targeted by *magic missile*
spells.description: You yell "Nope!" and an invisible barrier snaps into place. Until the start of your next turn you have +5 AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.

spells.name: Wisp Armor
ranks: You also gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points when you cast it.
Temporary hit points become 2d4 + 8. While you have them, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage.
Base AC 14 + Dexterity modifier. Temporary hit points 3d4 + 12, cold damage 10.
You can cast it on a willing creature you touch. When the temporary hit points run out, the wisps burst: creatures within 5 feet take 2d6 radiant damage.
spells.note: Wisps: they're like armor, but they judge you.
spells.description: Pale wisps of light orbit you like angry fireflies. While you wear no armor, your base AC becomes 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

spells.name: Patch Job
ranks: 6d8 + modifier. It also ends the Poisoned condition.
10d8 + modifier. You can split the healing between two creatures you touch.
spells.description: You slap a glowing bandage on a creature. It regains 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points.

spells.name: Shout It Off
ranks: 6d4 + modifier. A creature you heal from 0 hit points can stand up from Prone without spending movement.
spells.description: You yell "Walk it off!" at a creature you can see, and it does. It regains 2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points.

spells.name: Bad Touch
ranks: 4d10 necrotic damage. On a failure, the target also has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.
6d10 necrotic damage. You regain hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.
spells.note: The System reminds you to wash your hands.
spells.description: Your hand turns gray and wet. A creature you touch makes a Constitution saving throw. It takes 2d10 necrotic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Spotlight
ranks: 4d6 radiant damage, next attack has advantage.
6d6 radiant damage. Every attack roll against the target has advantage until the end of your next turn, not only the next one.
8d6 radiant damage. On a hit, the target can't become Invisible or hide until the end of your next turn.
spells.note: Everyone gets their moment in the spotlight. Some people just get it at very high velocity.
spells.description: A beam of stage light slams into a creature. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn has advantage.

spells.name: Glitter Bomb
ranks: Sparkling creatures also have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 24 hours. The glitter never truly comes off.
A sparkling creature that takes damage from an attack also takes 1d6 radiant damage (once per turn).
spells.note: Glitter is forever. Ask anyone who's been to a kid's birthday party.
spells.description: A burst of glitter fills a 20-foot cube. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it sparkles for the duration: it sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius, can't benefit from being Invisible, and attack rolls against it have advantage.

spells.name: Nap Time
ranks: 15-foot radius. Sleeping creatures snore loudly and have disadvantage on the first save they make after waking.
Creatures that succeed on the first save still have their speed halved until the end of their next turn.
spells.description: A lullaby only monsters can hear. Each creature you choose in a 5-foot-radius sphere makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, then repeats the save. If it fails again, it has the Unconscious condition until the spell ends, it takes damage, or someone uses an action to shake it awake. Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves and undead, are immune.

spells.name: New Best Friend
ranks: Three creatures. The spell now works on any creature type except constructs and undead.
Five creatures. When the spell ends, a creature that failed its save doesn't realize it was charmed.
spells.description: A humanoid or beast you can see makes a Wisdom saving throw, with advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failure, it has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. It regards you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends, it knows it was charmed.

spells.name: Sit. Stay.
ranks: Three creatures. You can give each one a different word.
Five creatures. A creature that fails the save also takes 2d8 psychic damage if it disobeys on purpose.
spells.note: Good monster. Who's a good monster?
spells.description: You bark a one-word command. A creature that can hear you makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it follows the command on its next turn: Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel (falls Prone) or Halt. You can try another single word, which the GM interprets.

spells.name: Crowd Goes Wild
ranks: Three creatures, +1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.
Five creatures. Each target also can't be Frightened while the spell lasts.
Seven creatures. Each target gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns.
spells.description: You cue imaginary applause. Up to three creatures of your choice add 1d4 to every attack roll and saving throw they make until the spell ends.

spells.name: Booed Off Stage
ranks: Five creatures. Affected creatures also can't take reactions.
spells.description: Phantom boos rain down from nowhere. Up to three creatures you can see make Charisma saving throws. Each one that fails subtracts 1d4 from every attack roll and saving throw it makes until the spell ends.

spells.name: Quest Marker
ranks: +1d8 force damage. Your allies can see the arrow too.
Duration 24 hours. Taking damage doesn't break your concentration on it.
+1d10 force damage. You always know which direction the target is, if it is on the same floor.
spells.note: QUEST UPDATED: Kill that guy.
spells.description: A floating yellow arrow appears over a creature's head, visible only to you. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 force damage to it whenever you hit it with an attack, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception and Survival) checks to find it. If it drops to 0 hit points before the spell ends, you can move the marker to a new creature as a bonus action.

spells.name: Jinx
ranks: The target also can't regain hit points while it is under 10 hit points.
+1d8 necrotic damage, and once per turn the target rolls a d4 and subtracts it from an attack roll it makes.
spells.description: You curse a creature with very bad luck. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage to it whenever you hit it with an attack, and it has disadvantage on ability checks using one ability of your choice. If it drops to 0 hit points, you can move the jinx to a new creature as a bonus action.

spells.name: Smackdown
ranks: +4d8 radiant damage. A target that is Large or smaller also has the Prone condition.
+6d8 radiant damage. If the hit was a critical hit, the smite costs no mana.
spells.note: And the crowd goes WILD!
spells.casting_time: 1 bonus action, right after you hit with a melee weapon or an unarmed strike
spells.description: You drop the elbow from the top rope of heaven. The target takes an extra 2d8 radiant damage. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a fiend or undead.

spells.name: Signature Move
ranks: +3d6 damage. Saving throws against your move have disadvantage.
spells.casting_time: 1 bonus action, right after you hit with a weapon or unarmed strike
spells.description:
You add a finishing move with your own name on it. The target takes an extra 1d6 damage, and you choose one move:
• Scorcher. Fire damage. The target burns for 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it or a creature next to it uses an action to put it out.
• Stare-Down. Psychic damage. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw or is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn.
• Ring the Bell. Thunder damage. The target makes a Strength saving throw or is pushed 10 feet and falls Prone.
• Snare. Piercing damage. The target makes a Strength saving throw or is Restrained by vines until the end of its next turn.
• Tailwind. Force damage. You can move up to 30 feet this turn without provoking opportunity attacks.

spells.name: Brand Deal
ranks: The target also adds 1d4 to Constitution saving throws.
The target also deals an extra 1d4 radiant damage with its weapon attacks.
spells.note: This protection is brought to you by a sponsor who wishes to remain anonymous. For legal reasons.
spells.description: A glowing sponsor logo appears on a creature's chest. It gains +2 AC until the spell ends.

spells.name: Callout
ranks: Attacking another creature no longer ends the spell.
You have advantage on saving throws against effects caused by the targets.
Three creatures. A target that attacks someone other than you takes 2d6 psychic damage.
spells.description: "You! Yeah, you!" A creature you can see makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you, and it can't willingly move more than 30 feet away from you. The spell ends if you attack someone else or move more than 30 feet from it.

spells.name: Skin Suit
ranks: Look like someone else for 1 hour.
You can sound like them too.
Duration 8 hours. The change can make you look up to 1 foot taller or shorter, or one size larger or smaller.
Your Interface tag shows a fake name to anyone who Inspects you.
Touch no longer gives you away, and creatures have disadvantage on the check to see through it.
spells.note: The System does not endorse wearing other crawlers. It does endorse the ratings.
spells.description: You change how you look, including your clothes and gear, to a creature of your shape and roughly your size. It is an illusion: a creature that touches you or uses an action to study you can see through it with an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

spells.name: Deep Inspect
spells.allowed_classes: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard
ranks: As an action, Inspect one object you touch: learn its properties, how to use it, its charges and any curse.
You also sense aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead within 30 feet, and where they are.
Range becomes 60 feet, and the spell lasts 1 hour.
Once per casting, Inspect a creature you can see: learn its current hit points, one resistance and one vulnerability.
spells.description: Your Interface's Inspect window opens up in ways it really shouldn't. For the duration, you sense magic, poison and disease within 30 feet, and you can see a faint aura around any visible creature or object that holds them, along with its school of magic. Barriers of 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal or a sheet of lead block it.

spells.name: Zoomies
ranks: One creature, +10 feet speed, triple jump distance.
The target can also take the Dash action as a bonus action on each of its turns.
Four creatures. Targets ignore difficult terrain.
spells.description: A creature you touch gets the zoomies. Its speed increases by 10 feet, and its jump distances are tripled.

spells.name: Soft Landing
ranks: Targets can steer, moving up to 30 feet sideways for every 60 feet they fall.
Targets can float up or down at 30 feet per round instead, for the whole minute.
spells.casting_time: 1 reaction, when you or a creature within 60 feet falls
spells.description: Up to five falling creatures in range drift down at 60 feet per round. A creature that lands before the spell ends takes no falling damage, lands on its feet, and the spell ends for it.

spells.name: Smoke Machine
ranks: Lasers! You and creatures you choose can see through the fog.
60-foot radius. You can move the fog 20 feet as a bonus action.
Creatures you choose that start their turn in the fog take 2d6 poison damage.
spells.note: Now with Unce Unce scent!
spells.description: You fill a 20-foot-radius sphere with thick, scented club fog. The area is Heavily Obscured. A wind of 10 miles per hour or more disperses it.

spells.name: Grabby Vines
ranks: Restrained creatures take 1d6 piercing damage at the start of each of their turns.
Piercing damage becomes 2d6, and the vines can pull a restrained creature 10 feet as a bonus action.
spells.description: Vines burst out of the cracks in a 20-foot square. The area is Difficult Terrain. Each creature in the area when you cast it makes a Strength saving throw or is Restrained by the vines until the spell ends. A restrained creature can use an action to repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spells.name: Intern
ranks: Interns have Strength 10 and can help you with an ability check (giving advantage, once per check).
Interns can carry an unconscious creature to safety, and they have 20 hit points.
spells.note: Interns are not paid. They are paid in experience. And by experience, we mean death.
spells.description: An invisible, unpaid intern appears. It has AC 10, 1 hit point and Strength 2, and can't attack. As a bonus action, you can tell it to do a simple task: fetch, carry, clean, mend, fold clothes, light fires, serve food or pour drinks. It moves 15 feet per turn.

spells.name: Hench-Critter
ranks: It gets +1 hit point per your level and adds your proficiency bonus to its AC and saves.
It can talk, badly, and can take the Help action as a bonus action on its turn.
It can become invisible as an action, until it attacks or casts.
You can share its senses at any range on the same floor.
spells.description: A tiny critter swears loyalty to you: a bat, cat, crab, frog, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, rat, raven, spider or weasel, in a spirit form (celestial, fey or fiend). It acts independently, but obeys your commands. While it is within 100 feet, you can see through its eyes and hear through its ears, and it can deliver touch spells you cast. If it drops to 0 hit points it vanishes; cast the spell again to bring it back. It is not a pet (see pets): it doesn't count as your active pet.

spells.name: Doorbell
ranks: You see an image of the creature that rang it.
The doorbell bites: the creature makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 4d6 lightning damage.
spells.description: You ward a door, window or area no larger than a 20-foot cube. When a creature you didn't name enters it, a doorbell rings: either a mental ping that wakes you, or a chime everyone within 60 feet hears.

spells.name: Clapback
ranks: 4d10 fire damage. On a failure, the target also burns for 1d10 fire damage at the start of its next turn.
6d10 fire damage. You can also use it when an ally within 30 feet is damaged.
spells.note: Ratio.
spells.casting_time: 1 reaction, when a creature you can see within 60 feet damages you
spells.description: You respond. The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 2d10 fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Laugh Track
ranks: Damage no longer gives the target advantage on the repeat save.
Four creatures. Each creature that fails takes 1d6 psychic damage at the end of each of its turns.
spells.description: A creature hears a sitcom laugh track nobody else can hear. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it falls Prone, laughing, and has the Incapacitated condition until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns, and whenever it takes damage, it repeats the save, with advantage if damage triggered it. Creatures with Intelligence 4 or lower don't get the joke.

spells.name: Intrusive Thoughts
ranks: 5d6 psychic damage. The creature can't take the Dash action on its next turn either.
spells.description: You whisper the worst thing someone has ever thought. A creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes 3d6 psychic damage and must use its reaction, if available, to move as far away from you as its speed allows. On a success, it takes half as much damage.

spells.name: Food Poisoning
ranks: 4d8 poison damage. A poisoned target can't take reactions.
6d8 poison damage. A poisoned target spends its next action retching.
spells.description: A greenish ray of gas-station sushi. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 poison damage and makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it also has the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Pet Translator
ranks: You can also talk to plants and fungi.
You have advantage on Animal Handling checks while the spell lasts. Your pet gains +2 to its bond checks (see pets).
Duration 8 hours, and you can talk to monstrosities with Intelligence 3 or lower.
spells.note: Your cat thinks you're an idiot. We translated it so you don't have to.
spells.description: You can talk to beasts and understand them. Their knowledge is limited by their intelligence, but they can tell you about nearby places and monsters.

spells.name: Snack Break
ranks: You can also make a full meal for up to fifteen creatures, with water.
Each berry heals 1d4 + 2 and ends one disease.
Twenty berries. A creature that eats one gains advantage on its next saving throw against poison.
spells.description: Ten gummy berries appear in your hand. A creature can eat one as a bonus action to regain 1 hit point. Each berry is a full meal for the day. You can also purify all food and drink within 5 feet of you, or make 10 gallons of clean water.

spells.name: Subtitles
ranks: Understand any language you hear or read.
You can write a hidden message only creatures you choose can read.
You can speak a language you hear, badly.
Duration 8 hours. You can also read codes and secret messages.
You can speak and understand every language fluently. Creatures you choose understand you too.
spells.description: Subtitles appear in your vision for every language you hear or read. You don't decode codes or magic writing.

spells.name: Protective Shell
ranks: 10-foot radius, until the start of your next turn.
Duration becomes concentration, up to 1 minute.
Creatures pushed out of the dome take 3d6 force damage.
20-foot radius. Ranged attacks from outside can't pass through the dome at all.
spells.note: Personal space: now available in dome form.
spells.description: A shimmering dome slams down around you. Each hostile creature in the dome is pushed straight out to the nearest point outside it, without a saving throw. Until the start of your next turn, hostile creatures can't enter the dome, and attacks made from outside it against creatures inside have disadvantage. You and your allies can leave and enter freely. The dome moves with you.

spells.name: Tentacle Hug
ranks: 4d6 necrotic damage. Creatures that fail also have their speed halved until the start of your next turn.
6d6 necrotic damage. You choose which creatures in the area are affected.
spells.description: Inky tentacles burst out around you for a quick, nasty hug. Each creature within 10 feet of you makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes 2d6 necrotic damage and can't take reactions until the start of its next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage.

spells.name: Puddle Jumper
ranks: You can bring one willing creature you touch. It arrives next to you.
Teleport 90 feet. You can also jump to a space you saw in the last minute, even if you can't see it now.
Bring up to two creatures. When you arrive, creatures of your choice within 5 feet get splashed: 2d6 cold damage, no save.
spells.note: Puddle Jumper! Not available on floors without puddles. All floors have puddles. Don't ask what's in them.
spells.description: You step into the floor like it's a puddle and pop out of another one. Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You arrive slightly damp.

spells.name: Lights Out
ranks: You can see through your own darkness.
20-foot radius. Creatures you choose can see through it too.
Creatures that can't see through it have disadvantage on concentration saves while inside.
30-foot radius. Your darkness snuffs out magical light of 3rd level or lower.
spells.description: Somebody hit the breaker. Magical darkness fills a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point or an object you touch. Darkvision can't see through it, and nonmagical light can't light it.

spells.name: Now You Don't
ranks: Three creatures. The target also makes no sound while it moves.
Five creatures. The first attack an invisible target makes doesn't end the spell for it.
spells.note: Now you see me. Now you don't. Now the audience complains that they can't see anything.
spells.description: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends for it if it attacks, deals damage or casts a spell.

spells.name: Clockwork Triplicate
ranks: A copy that shatters sprays gears: the attacker takes 1d6 slashing damage.
As a bonus action, you can turn invisible and leave one copy standing in your place until the start of your next turn. The copy can talk and move as you direct it.
Four copies. Each copy can make a melee attack using your spell attack modifier as part of the spell's casting (1d6 force damage).
spells.note: Three of you! The audience asked for many things. This was not one of them.
spells.description: Two ticking, clockwork copies of you appear in your space. Each time a creature attacks you, roll a d6 for each copy. If any die rolls a 3 or higher, the attack hits a copy instead and the copy shatters into gears. A copy has AC 10 + your Dexterity modifier. Creatures with Blindsight or Truesight aren't fooled.

spells.name: Scorcher
ranks: Seven rays. A target hit by three or more rays in one casting catches fire: 2d6 fire damage at the start of its next turn.
spells.description: You shoot three rays of fire. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. Each ray deals 2d6 fire damage on a hit. They can hit the same target or different ones.

spells.name: Bass Drop
ranks: 5d8 thunder damage. Creatures that fail are also Deafened until the end of their next turn.
spells.note: WUB WUB WUB.
spells.description: You drop the bass at a point. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere makes a Constitution saving throw. It takes 3d8 thunder damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Constructs and creatures made of stone, crystal or metal have disadvantage. Nonmagical objects in the area that no one is holding take the damage too.

spells.name: Hold It Right There
spells.allowed_classes: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard
ranks: Three. The spell now works on any creature that isn't undead or a construct.
Five creatures. A target only repeats the save every other turn.
spells.description: You yell like a mall cop. A humanoid you can see makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it has the Paralyzed condition until the spell ends. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.

spells.name: Sticky Situation
ranks: Fire no longer burns it away.
30-foot cube. Restrained creatures can't cast spells with somatic components.
Restrained creatures take 2d6 acid damage at the start of each of their turns.
spells.description: Thick, sticky webbing fills a 20-foot cube. It is Difficult Terrain and Lightly Obscured. A creature that starts its turn there or enters it makes a Dexterity saving throw or is Restrained while it stays in the web. A restrained creature can use an action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC to break free. The web burns away in 1 round if fire touches it, dealing 2d4 fire damage to creatures in it.

spells.name: Acid Reflux
ranks: 6d4, then 4d4. The target also has −2 AC until the end of its next turn.
8d4, then 6d4. On a hit, the acid splashes onto one creature within 5 feet of the target for 2d4.
spells.description: You belch a green arrow of acid. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 acid damage, and 2d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, it takes half the first damage only.

spells.name: Hamster Ball of Fire
ranks: 4d6 fire damage. The ball can roll 60 feet and climb walls.
6d6 fire damage. Two balls, controlled with the same bonus action.
spells.note: Ethically sourced. No hamsters were harmed. Most hamsters were harmed.
spells.description: A 5-foot ball of fire rolls into being in an empty space. A creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. As a bonus action, roll the ball up to 30 feet. If you ram it into a creature, that creature makes the save, and the ball stops.

spells.name: Abduction Beam
ranks: 4d10 radiant damage. A creature that fails is lifted 10 feet into the air and dropped.
spells.description: A pale tractor beam shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder. When a creature enters it for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Constitution saving throw. It takes 2d10 radiant damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. A shapechanger has disadvantage and reverts to its true form on a failure. As a bonus action, you can move the beam 60 feet.

spells.name: Phantom Folding Chair
ranks: 3d8 + modifier. A Medium or smaller creature hit by the chair has the Prone condition.
5d8 + modifier. The chair also gives creatures within 5 feet of it half cover.
spells.note: Every wrestling fan knows: the chair is the most powerful weapon in the world.
spells.description: A glowing metal folding chair appears in the air near a creature and swings. Make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier force damage. As a bonus action on later turns, move the chair 20 feet and attack again.

spells.name: Halftime Show
ranks: +15 hit points. Targets also gain advantage on their next death saving throw.
spells.description: A quick, rousing halftime show. Up to three creatures each increase their hit point maximum and current hit points by 5 for the duration.

spells.name: Walk It Off
ranks: End two conditions, or one condition on two creatures.
Add Charmed and Frightened to the list.
The creature also regains 2d8 hit points.
spells.description: You end one condition on a creature you touch: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed or Poisoned, or one disease.

spells.name: Group Hug
ranks: 6d8 + modifier. It can now be cast as a bonus action.
