spells.description: Everyone comes in for a hug. Up to five creatures each regain 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points. A creature healed by this spell can't be healed by it again until it finishes a short rest.

spells.name: Mute Button
ranks: You can center it on a creature or object, and it moves with it.
30-foot radius. You can let sound out but not in, or in but not out.
Creatures you choose can talk normally inside it.
spells.note: You have been muted by the host.
spells.description: You press an invisible mute button. No sound can be made in or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere. Creatures inside are Deafened and immune to thunder damage, and can't cast spells with verbal components.

spells.name: Totally Your Idea
ranks: Three creatures. The suggestion can be 50 words.
The creature thinks the suggestion was its own idea, even after the spell ends.
Five creatures, and you can give each a different suggestion.
spells.description: You suggest a course of action, 25 words or fewer, that sounds reasonable. A creature that can hear and understand you makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it follows the suggestion as well as it can. The spell ends if you or your allies damage it.

spells.name: Chill Pill
ranks: Creatures that fail also regain 2d8 hit points from the relief.
spells.description: Everybody just chill. Each humanoid in a 20-foot-radius sphere makes a Charisma saving throw (a creature can choose to fail). On a failure, choose one: the Charmed and Frightened conditions end on it, or it becomes indifferent to creatures of your choice it was hostile toward, until the spell ends or it is attacked.

spells.name: Mind Peek
ranks: You also sense thinking creatures within 30 feet you can't see.
Duration 10 minutes. You can switch targets as a bonus action.
You can talk telepathically with the target.
One question per casting that the target answers truthfully in its head, if it fails the save.
spells.description: You read the surface thoughts of a creature you can see within 30 feet. As an action, probe deeper: it makes a Wisdom saving throw, and on a failure you learn its reasoning, emotions and something it is thinking about hard.

spells.name: Fact Check
ranks: A buzzer sounds when an affected creature dodges a question.
Creatures have disadvantage on the save.
An affected creature that tries to lie takes 2d8 psychic damage instead.
spells.note: Fact check: false. And you've been fined.
spells.description: A 15-foot-radius sphere becomes a no-lies zone. A creature that enters it or starts its turn there makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it can't knowingly lie while in the area. You know whether each creature succeeded. Affected creatures can still dodge questions.

spells.name: Treasure Sense
spells.allowed_classes: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger, Wizard
ranks: You also learn how far away it is.
Duration 1 hour. You sense the exact location of traps you have line of sight to.
You sense loot boxes (and their rarity) within 120 feet.
Range 1 mile. You can hide an object's magic from Inspect and detection spells for 24 hours.
spells.description: Name an object, or a kind of object, beast or plant. You sense the direction of the nearest one within 1,000 feet. You also sense any trap within 120 feet of you that you have line of sight to, but not exactly where it is.

spells.name: Night Goggles
ranks: You can also see Invisible creatures and objects, and into the Ethereal Plane.
Darkvision 120 feet, and magical darkness doesn't block it.
You can see through illusions within 30 feet as if they were translucent.
spells.description: A creature you touch gets green-tinted Darkvision out to 60 feet.

spells.name: Glow Up
spells.allowed_classes: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Ranger, Sorcerer, Wizard
ranks: One creature, one ability, or one self change.
Three creatures. Targets can choose a different ability each.
Targets also add +1 to saving throws with that ability.
spells.description: A creature you touch gets a makeover montage. Choose an ability. It has advantage on ability checks with that ability until the spell ends. Or, if you target yourself, you can grow gills, claws (1d6 + your spellcasting modifier slashing), or change your appearance for the duration.

spells.name: Supersize Me
ranks: Two creatures, or two sizes on one.
Duration 10 minutes, and it no longer needs concentration on a willing target.
spells.note: Upsize your crawler for only one more mana!
spells.description: A creature or object grows or shrinks one size. An unwilling creature makes a Constitution saving throw. Enlarged: advantage on Strength checks and saves, and its weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 damage. Reduced: disadvantage on Strength checks and saves, and its weapon attacks deal 1d4 less damage (minimum 1).

spells.name: Hot Potato
ranks: 4d8 fire damage. Metal armor counts, and its wearer can't take it off quickly.
spells.description: A manufactured metal object you can see glows red hot. A creature touching it takes 2d8 fire damage when you cast the spell. It must make a Constitution saving throw or drop it (if it can). Until it drops it, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. As a bonus action on later turns, deal the damage again.

spells.name: Weapon Upgrade
ranks: It also deals an extra 1d4 acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage (your choice).
+3 weapon, extra 3d4. Works on magic weapons too, adding only the extra damage.
spells.description: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a +1 weapon for the duration.

spells.name: Mount Up
ranks: The steed's walking speed increases by 20 feet.
The steed can fly at its walking speed.
The steed adds your proficiency bonus to its AC, attacks and damage.
Once per long rest, when the steed drops to 0 hit points, it reforms at full hit points at the start of your next turn.
spells.note: No, you cannot ride it into the safe room. Yes, people have tried.
spells.description: A spirit steed appears: a loyal, Large creature you ride. Use the Otherworldly Steed stat block (or a riding horse with an extra hit points equal to five times your level if your GM prefers). It acts on your turn and obeys you. If it dies, you can summon it again. It is not a pet (see pets).

spells.name: Ghost Mode
ranks: Divination magic and Inspect can't find or target you.
You also don't show up on any monster's detection sense, such as Blindsight or Tremorsense, beyond 10 feet.
Your group can't be seen by viewers either. You gain no Audience while it lasts, but sponsors can't cut your feed.
spells.description: You and creatures you choose within 30 feet of you have a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.

spells.name: Hidey Hole
ranks: Monsters can't find the door without Truesight.
Duration 8 hours. Counts as a safe place for a short rest (no Ambush Check).
It counts as a safe room for a long rest, once per floor. No shops. No bathrooms.
spells.note: It's not a safe room. Do not call it a safe room. Our lawyers are watching.
spells.description: You tap a wall or a rope, and an invisible door opens into a small extradimensional room. Up to eight Medium creatures fit inside. Attacks and spells can't pass in or out, but you can see out. Anything left inside drops out when the spell ends.

spells.name: Leaf Blower
ranks: Ranged weapon attacks through the wind have disadvantage.
Push 30 feet, and creatures that fail take 2d6 bludgeoning damage from flying junk.
You can wrap the wind around you instead: ranged attacks against you have disadvantage.
Push 60 feet, and creatures that fail fall Prone.
spells.description: A howling wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you. Each creature in the line makes a Strength saving throw or is pushed 15 feet away. The wind disperses gas and fog and puts out small flames. As a bonus action, change its direction.

spells.name: Noodle Arms
ranks: The target also drops anything heavier than 10 pounds when the spell starts.
All of its weapon attacks deal half damage, not only Strength ones.
spells.description: A creature's arms go floppy. It makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, its Strength-based weapon attacks deal half damage and it has disadvantage on Strength checks and saves until the spell ends. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

spells.name: Static Screen
ranks: Three creatures. You can choose Blinded and Deafened together.
Five creatures. The target repeats the save only every other turn.
spells.description: Static fills a creature's eyes or ears. It makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is Blinded or Deafened (your choice) for the duration. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

spells.name: Bar Fight
ranks: One creature, attacks your choice of target.
It also can't tell friend from foe: when it attacks, it chooses its targets at random from creatures it can see.
The target makes the attack with advantage.
spells.note: The best fights start with someone else.
spells.description: A creature hears the opening chords of a bar-fight song. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is Charmed, and on its turn it must use its action to attack a creature you choose other than itself, if one is in reach. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

spells.name: Deepfake
ranks: 4d8 psychic damage. Two creatures see the same fake.
spells.description: You put a convincing fake into a creature's mind. It makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, it sees an object, creature or effect no larger than a 10-foot cube, and treats it as real. If the fake is dangerous, it takes 2d8 psychic damage once per turn when it touches it or starts its turn next to it.

spells.name: Plus-One
ranks: You take only half the damage it takes.
spells.description: You bring a date to the dungeon. A willing creature you touch gains +1 AC, +1 to saving throws, and resistance to all damage. Each time it takes damage, you take the same amount. The spell ends if you are more than 60 feet apart.

spells.name: Freshness Seal
ranks: Food and monster parts also stay fresh.
Up to five bodies or containers.
A sealed body can be put into your inventory regardless of size.
spells.description: A body you touch is vacuum sealed. It doesn't decay, can't become undead, and the time doesn't count against spells that bring creatures back.

spells.name: Open Sesame
ranks: It also disarms one mechanical trap on the lock.
It opens one lock up to a boss room door (GM's call), once per floor.
spells.description: You speak the password. One locked door, box, chain or similar object opens. A magical lock is suppressed for 10 minutes. The spell is loud, audible 300 feet away.

spells.name: Deadbolt
ranks: Creatures touching it without permission take 2d6 lightning damage.
You know when someone tries to open it, and where it is, on the same floor.
spells.description: A door, window, gate or chest you touch locks magically. You and creatures you name can open it normally. Anyone else needs to break it (DC raised by 10) or open it with magic.

spells.name: Lego Floor
ranks: 4d4 piercing per 5 feet. Creatures that take the damage also lose their reaction until their next turn.
spells.note: Pain. Pure, barefoot pain.
spells.description: A 20-foot-radius area fills with sharp, hard to see little plastic bricks. It is Difficult Terrain. A creature takes 2d4 piercing damage for every 5 feet it moves through it. A creature that didn't see you cast it needs a Wisdom (Perception) check against your spell save DC to notice the danger.

spells.name: Toughen Up
ranks: It also gains 5 temporary hit points.
Temporary hit points 10. AC at least 18.
spells.description: A creature's skin turns bark tough. Its AC can't be lower than 17.

spells.name: Tripwire
ranks: 3d6 piercing. A creature that fails also has its speed halved until the end of its turn.
4d6 piercing, and you know when each shot fires.
spells.description: You set up to four pieces of ammunition in the ground as a magical trip-wire turret. When a creature you didn't name comes within 30 feet of them, one fires: the creature makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 2d4 piercing damage. Each piece fires once.

spells.name: Summon Critter
ranks: At level 3, or a pack: three spirits at level 2 that share one turn and one hit point total.
At level 4. It has advantage on attacks against creatures next to your active pet.
At level 6. It no longer needs concentration.
spells.note: Don't name it. It's a summon. Okay, you named it.
spells.description: A spirit beast appears: land, air or water. Use the Bestial Spirit stat block at a spell level of 2 + your rank − 1. It obeys you, acts right after you, and vanishes at 0 hit points. It is not a pet (see pets).

spells.name: Kaboom
ranks: 10d6 fire damage. You can make a pocket in the blast: up to three creatures you choose take no damage.
12d6 fire damage. You can delay the blast up to 1 minute. It goes off when you choose (no action) or when a creature touches the bead.
spells.note: KABOOM! The single most popular spell among viewers, for nine seasons running.
spells.description: A bead of fire streaks to a point you choose and explodes. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 8d6 fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Flammable objects in the area that no one is holding start burning.

spells.name: Power Surge
ranks: 10d6 lightning damage. The line can bend once, at a point you choose.
12d6 lightning damage. Creatures that fail can't take reactions until the start of their next turn.
spells.description: You overload the dungeon's wiring in a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 8d6 lightning damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Storm Chaser
ranks: 5d10 lightning damage. You can call a bolt as a bonus action instead of an action.
spells.description: A storm cloud gathers under the ceiling. When you cast it, and as an action on later turns, call a bolt down on a point under the cloud. Each creature within 5 feet of that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Unsubscribe
ranks: Caster saves to keep the spell.
The caster has disadvantage on the save if the spell is 3rd level or lower.
If the spell fails, you regain 2 mana.
The caster has disadvantage on the save if the spell is 5th level or lower.
If the spell fails and it targeted only you, you can cast it back at its caster, using the caster's DC.
spells.note: You have been unsubscribed. We're sorry to see you go. Not really.
spells.casting_time: 1 reaction, when you see a creature within 60 feet casting a spell
spells.description: You hit "unsubscribe" on someone's spell. The caster makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the spell fails, and any mana or slot it used is wasted.

spells.name: Factory Reset
spells.allowed_classes: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard
ranks: Ends spells of 3rd level or lower automatically.
5th level or lower. Add your proficiency bonus to the check for higher spells.
7th level or lower. You can target every creature and object of your choice in a 20-foot radius.
spells.note: Have you tried turning it off and on again?
spells.description: You turn something off and on again. Choose a creature, object or magical effect. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on it ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher, make an ability check with your spellcasting ability (DC 10 + the spell's level). On a success, it ends. You can also end one curse on a creature you touch, and break a cursed item's hold on its owner.

spells.name: Fast Forward
ranks: The lag after the spell ends lasts only until the start of its next turn instead.
The extra Attack action allows two weapon attacks.
Three creatures, and no lag when the spell ends.
spells.description: A willing creature plays at double speed. Its speed doubles, it gains +2 AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saves, and it gets one extra action on each of its turns (Attack with one weapon attack only, Dash, Disengage, Hide or Use an Object). When the spell ends, the target is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn as the lag catches up.

spells.name: Buffering
ranks: Eight creatures. Affected creatures repeat the save only every other turn.
Ten creatures. Affected creatures can't Dash.
spells.note: Your opponent is experiencing technical difficulties. Please stand by.
spells.description: Up to six creatures in a 40-foot cube start buffering. Each makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, its speed is halved, it takes −2 to AC and Dexterity saves, it can't take reactions, and on its turn it can take either an action or a bonus action, not both. It can't make more than one attack on its turn. If it casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action, roll a d20: on 11 or higher, the spell doesn't take effect until its next turn. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

spells.name: Jetpack
ranks: Three creatures. If the spell ends, targets float down safely.
Five creatures. It no longer needs concentration.
spells.description: A glowing jetpack straps itself to a willing creature. It gains a flying speed of 60 feet. If the spell ends while it is in the air, it falls.

spells.name: Respawn
ranks: It returns with hit points equal to your level.
Within 1 hour. The diamond only needs to be worth 100 gp.
It returns with half its hit points, and the System doesn't count the death for achievements.
spells.note: Respawning is a privilege, not a right. Mostly it's a diamond.
spells.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. It returns to life with 1 hit point. It can't return if it died of old age, and it doesn't regrow missing body parts.

spells.name: Mosh Pit
ranks: 5d8 damage. Creatures that fail are pushed 5 feet in a direction you choose.
spells.description: Spectral fans mosh in a 15-foot circle around you. Choose any number of creatures you can see to ignore them. The area is Difficult Terrain for other creatures. When a creature enters the area on a turn or ends its turn there, it makes a Wisdom saving throw, taking 3d8 radiant or necrotic damage (your choice when you cast it) on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Screensaver
ranks: You choose which creatures are affected.
40-foot cube. When the logo hits a corner, affected creatures take 2d6 psychic damage (once per round, at the start of your turn, without waking).
Taking damage gives a repeat save instead of ending it.
spells.note: Will it hit the corner? WILL IT?
spells.description: A bouncing, color-shifting logo hangs in a 30-foot cube. Each creature in it that can see it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is Charmed and Incapacitated, with speed 0, until the spell ends. It snaps out of it if it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake it.

spells.name: Fear
ranks: Frightened creatures take 2d6 psychic damage at the start of each of their turns.
Creatures of CR 1 or lower that fail don't just run: they flee the area entirely and don't come back for an hour.
spells.note: Fear: it's what's for dinner. Specifically, yours.
spells.description: You show every creature in a 30-foot cone its worst nightmare. Each one makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it drops whatever it is holding, is Frightened of you, and on each of its turns must Dash away from you by the safest route. If it ends its turn where it can't see you, it repeats the save.

spells.name: One-Star Review
ranks: Duration 8 hours, and it no longer needs concentration.
spells.description: You leave a one-star review on someone's soul. The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, choose one: disadvantage on checks and saves with one ability; disadvantage on attack rolls against you; it wastes its action on a roll of 1–5 on a d10 each turn; or your attacks and spells deal an extra 1d8 necrotic damage to it.

spells.name: Gas Station Bathroom
ranks: Creatures that fail also take 2d6 poison damage.
The gas follows a creature you choose, staying centered on it.
spells.note: We don't want to talk about it.
spells.description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of nauseating gas. It is Heavily Obscured. Each creature that starts its turn in it makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is Poisoned and spends its action retching.

spells.name: Slushie Storm
ranks: Creatures that fail also take 2d6 cold damage.
Your allies can see through it.
spells.description: Blue-raspberry sleet falls in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder. The area is Heavily Obscured and Difficult Terrain, and open flames go out. A creature that enters it or starts its turn there makes a Dexterity saving throw or falls Prone. A creature concentrating in it makes a Constitution save against your DC or loses concentration.

spells.name: Stadium Lights
ranks: Undead and fiends in the bright light have disadvantage on attack rolls.
When you cast it, each creature of your choice in the bright light makes a Constitution save or is Blinded until the end of its next turn.
Undead that start their turn in the bright light take 2d8 radiant damage.
spells.description: Floodlights blaze from a point or an object you touch: bright light in a 60-foot radius, dim light for 60 feet beyond. It is sunlight. It dispels magical darkness of 3rd level or lower.

spells.name: Security Cam
ranks: Casting time 1 action. The camera is invisible and flies 30 feet per turn as you direct it. It has Darkvision 30 feet.
See and hear at once. Duration 1 hour.
The camera records: you can replay what it saw for 24 hours (and show it to others).
spells.description: A floating camera appears at a place you know or can see within range. You can see or hear through it as if you were there.

spells.name: Group Chat
ranks: For 1 hour you can also understand and speak every language.
You make a group chat: up to eight willing creatures link telepathically for 1 hour, any distance on the same floor.
spells.note: New message in Party Chat.
spells.description: You send a 25-word message to a creature you know on the same floor. It hears you in its head, recognizes you, and can reply at once in 25 words.

spells.name: Exit Interview
ranks: Ten questions. It must answer truthfully.
It can tell you what its last minute looked like.
You can ask a dead crawler about its loot: it tells you what it was carrying and where it stashed anything.
spells.note: We value your feedback. Even from beyond the grave.
spells.description: A corpse with a mouth answers up to five questions. It knows only what it knew in life, and it doesn't have to be honest, or nice.

spells.name: Weatherproofing
spells.allowed_classes: Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger, Sorcerer, Wizard
ranks: One creature can choose two types.
Immunity instead of resistance, for one creature.
spells.description: A willing creature gains resistance to one damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder.

spells.name: Snorkel
ranks: Breathe underwater or walk on liquid.
Targets also gain a swimming speed equal to their walking speed.
Targets also ignore toxic gases and smoke.
Targets can't drown or suffocate in any way.
spells.description: Up to ten willing creatures can breathe underwater, or walk on water and other liquids (your choice for each).

spells.name: Juice Box
ranks: 5d6 necrotic damage. You can make the attack as a bonus action instead.
7d6 necrotic damage. You regain hit points equal to all the damage.
spells.description: Your touch slurps life like a straw. Make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 necrotic damage, and you regain hit points equal to half the damage. You can attack again as an action on later turns.

spells.name: Void Pocket
ranks: 4d6 each. You can see in it.
6d6 each. Creatures inside can't teleport out.
spells.description: You open a 20-foot-radius sphere of empty, hungry space. It is Darkness, Difficult Terrain, and silent. A creature that starts its turn inside takes 2d6 cold damage. A creature that ends its turn inside makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 2d6 acid damage.

spells.name: Team Jersey
ranks: Allies in the area also gain +1 to saving throws.
Allies in the area can't be Frightened.
spells.note: Go team! Which team? Doesn't matter. GO TEAM!
spells.description: Glowing team jerseys appear on you and your allies. Allies within 30 feet of you deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage when they hit with a weapon or unarmed strike.

spells.name: Bullet Hell
ranks: 7d8 damage. Or instead, a 40-foot-radius area within 150 feet. For 1 minute after casting, you can make two extra ranged weapon attacks as a bonus action each turn.
9d8 damage. You choose creatures in the area to avoid.
spells.description: You fire one piece of ammunition or throw one weapon, and it becomes a hundred. Each creature in a 60-foot cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d8 damage of the weapon's type on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Pep Rally
ranks: 4d4 + modifier. Each creature also ends the Frightened condition.
6d4 + modifier. Each creature gains advantage on its next attack roll.
spells.description: "LET'S GO!" Up to six creatures you can see each regain 2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points.

spells.name: Booby Prize
ranks: 7d8 damage, or 5th level. Finding the glyph needs a check with disadvantage.
9d8 damage. You can place two glyphs with one casting.
spells.note: Congratulations, you've won a prize! It's an explosion.
spells.description: You draw an invisible glyph on a surface or inside an object. Choose its trigger. When triggered, it explodes in a 20-foot radius: each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d8 acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Or you can store a spell of 3rd level or lower in it, cast when triggered.

spells.name: Pop-Up Tent
ranks: Divination and Inspect can't see in, and no sound gets out.
Counts as a safe place for short rests: no Ambush Check.
20-foot radius, and you can leave without ending it.
Once per floor, it counts as a safe room for a long rest.
spells.note: Pitch a tent in the World Dungeon! What could go wrong? Everything. Everything could go wrong.
spells.description: A pop-up tent made of force snaps open around you, big enough for ten Medium creatures. Creatures and objects you didn't choose can't get in. Spells can't reach in. The inside is comfortable and dry. It ends if you leave it.

spells.name: Overgrowth
ranks: You and your allies have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in it.
Each creature in it when you cast it makes a Strength save or is Restrained for 1 minute (action to repeat).
You can grow ingredients: gain 1d4 T1 Monster Parts or flavor materials for crafting (once per floor).
spells.description: Plants burst through the floor in a 100-foot radius. Each 5 feet of movement there costs 20 feet. You can leave clearings in it. Or, over 8 hours, make crops or a garden thrive.

spells.name: Lag Spike
ranks: You can return up to 30 feet away.
You choose whether to vanish each turn instead of rolling.
spells.note: Lag is not an excuse. Unless you cast this. Then it is.
spells.description: You start lagging out of reality. At the end of each of your turns, roll a d6. On 4–6, you vanish to the Ethereal Plane until the start of your next turn, then return to a space of your choice within 10 feet of where you left.

spells.name: Play Dead
ranks: The target can still see and hear.
The target can end it as a bonus action.
Monsters lose interest: a creature that thinks a target is dead won't attack it unless it attacks first.
spells.description: A willing creature looks dead to everything, including Inspect. It is Blinded and Incapacitated, its speed is 0, it has resistance to all damage except psychic, and diseases and poison pause.

spells.name: Underdog Story
ranks: Targets gain 5 temporary hit points at the start of each of their turns.
Targets that drop to 0 hit points drop to 1 instead (once each per casting).
spells.note: The audience LOVES an underdog. Especially when they die anyway.
spells.description: Cue the inspirational music. Any number of creatures you choose have advantage on Wisdom saves and death saves, and regain the maximum possible hit points from any healing.

spells.name: Phone a Friend
spells.allowed_classes: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard
ranks: Spirit at level 3: fey, undead or shadow.
Level 4. Adds aberration, construct and elemental.
Level 7. It no longer needs concentration.
spells.note: Your friend has accepted the call. Your friend is a horror from beyond. Your friend says hi.
spells.description: You make a call and a spirit friend answers. Choose a kind your class or source allows: fey, undead or shadow at Rank I; also aberration, construct or elemental at Rank II; celestial or dragon at Rank III; fiend at Rank IV. It uses the matching Summon stat block from the 2024 Player's Handbook (or the book it comes from), at spell level 3 + your rank − 1. It obeys you and acts right after you. It vanishes at 0 hit points.

spells.name: Skeleton Crew
ranks: One new undead, or reassert four.
Three new, or reassert eight. Your undead add your proficiency bonus to damage.
Five new, or reassert twelve. Your undead gain hit points equal to your level.
spells.note: Union rules require undead workers to be given one break per century.
spells.description: You raise a pile of bones or a corpse as a skeleton or zombie (2024 Monster Manual). As a bonus action you command your undead within 60 feet. They obey for 24 hours, then you must cast the spell again on them (reasserting control of up to four) or they go free.

spells.name: Creature Feature
ranks: You can choose a beast up to CR 1 higher for a willing target.
Monstrosities count as beasts for this spell.
A willing target can switch between its forms as a bonus action for the duration.
spells.note: Congratulations! You are now a frog. The audience thanks you for your service.
spells.description: You turn a creature into a beast. An unwilling target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it becomes a beast of your choice with a CR no higher than its CR (or level), using the beast's stat block, and gains temporary hit points equal to the beast's hit points. It keeps its personality. It reverts when the temporary hit points run out or the spell ends.

spells.name: Ban Hammer
ranks: Three creatures. A creature that succeeds still takes 4d8 force damage.
Five creatures. The target has disadvantage on the save if it attacked you last turn.
spells.note: You have been banned. Reason: being a jerk. Appeals: no.
spells.description: A giant glowing gavel comes down. A creature makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it is banished to a harmless waiting room and is Incapacitated there until the spell ends. If the spell lasts the full minute and the creature is not from this plane, it doesn't come back.

spells.name: Shortcut
ranks: You can teleport through the floor to a stairwell you have seen on this floor, any distance.
spells.description: You teleport to a spot within range that you can see, picture or describe ("200 feet straight down"). You can bring one willing creature you touch. If you would arrive in an occupied space, you take 4d6 force damage and fail.

spells.name: Stealth Mode
ranks: The creature also makes no sound and leaves no scent.
spells.description: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends, even if it attacks or casts spells.

spells.name: Firewall
ranks: 7d8 fire damage. You can let creatures you choose pass through unharmed.
spells.note: Your firewall has blocked 14 intruders. Also, 14 intruders are on fire.
spells.description: You make a wall of fire up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high and 1 foot thick, or a ring 20 feet across. Each creature in its area when it appears makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d8 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. One side of the wall (your choice) deals 5d8 fire damage to a creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of it or enters the wall.

spells.name: Hail Mary
spells.description: Hail the size of footballs falls in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 2d10 bludgeoning and 4d6 cold damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. The area is Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Tentacle Party
ranks: 5d6 bludgeoning. Restrained creatures can't speak (a tentacle is in the way).
spells.note: The less said about this one, the better. The ratings, however, were spectacular.
spells.description: Rubbery black tentacles fill a 20-foot square. It is Difficult Terrain. A creature that enters it for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage and is Restrained until the spell ends. A restrained creature takes the damage at the start of each of its turns, and can use an action to make a Strength or Dexterity check against your spell save DC to escape.

spells.name: Glitch
ranks: 20-foot radius. You choose which creatures are affected.
A glitching creature takes 2d6 psychic damage when it does nothing.
spells.description: Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere start glitching. Each makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it can't take reactions and rolls a d10 at the start of each of its turns: 1, it moves in a random direction; 2–6, it does nothing; 7–8, it attacks a random creature in reach; 9–10, it acts normally. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

spells.name: Nightmare Fuel
ranks: 6d10 psychic damage. It is also Frightened of you while affected.
spells.description: A creature sees the thing it fears most. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes 4d10 psychic damage and has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls for the duration. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, taking the damage again on a failure.

spells.name: Stone Cold
ranks: It also can't be knocked Prone or pushed against its will.
It also has advantage on Strength saves, and the diamond dust is no longer needed.
spells.description: A willing creature's skin turns to granite. It has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

spells.name: Greased Up
ranks: Three creatures. Creatures that try to grapple it have disadvantage.
spells.note: Lubricated for your safety.
spells.description: A willing creature is slippery all over. Difficult Terrain doesn't slow it, spells and magic can't reduce its speed or Paralyze or Restrain it, and it can spend 5 feet of movement to escape a grapple or bonds. Underwater, it moves and attacks normally.

spells.name: Extra Life
ranks: When it triggers, the creature also gains 10 temporary hit points.
spells.note: EXTRA LIFE! Collect a hundred coins for another. That's a joke. You only get the one.
spells.description: A floating 1-UP icon circles a creature. The first time it would drop to 0 hit points, it drops to 1 instead, and the spell ends. If it is hit by an effect that would kill it outright, that effect fails instead, and the spell ends.

spells.name: Bouncer
ranks: 30 damage, after 100. It also shoves: a creature that fails is pushed 10 feet.
spells.note: Name's not on the list.
spells.description: A huge, spectral bouncer appears in an empty space and folds its arms. Any enemy that moves within 10 feet of it for the first time on a turn makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 20 radiant damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The bouncer vanishes after dealing 60 damage in total.

spells.name: Good Vibes Only
ranks: Allies also have advantage on saves against spells, and take no damage on a successful save that would deal half.
Allies regain 1d6 hit points at the start of each of their turns if they have at least 1.
spells.description: Good vibes radiate from you. You and your allies in the area have resistance to necrotic and poison damage, can't have their hit point maximum reduced, and have advantage on saves against the Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned and Stunned conditions. An ally at 0 hit points that starts its turn there regains 1 hit point.

spells.name: Pet Hijack
ranks: It works on another crawler's pet (the pet has advantage on the save).
8 hours. Monstrosities count as beasts for this spell.
spells.description: A beast makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is Charmed by you, and you control it telepathically on the same floor. As a bonus action you can take over its whole turn. Each time it takes damage it repeats the save.

spells.name: Conga Line
ranks: Move them with your bonus action.
Affected creatures also can't take reactions.
You can make them dance in a line: all affected creatures move in the same direction.
Affected creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls while they dance.
You can also make one affected creature take the Dash or Disengage action on its turn.
spells.note: Conga line! Conga line! Into the lava pit! Conga line!
spells.description: Everyone, conga! Any number of creatures you choose that can hear you make Wisdom saving throws. On a failure, as a bonus action each turn, you can make an affected creature use its movement to dance in a direction you choose, without safety concerns.

spells.name: Bubble Wrap
ranks: Creatures outside can roll it 30 feet as a bonus action.
spells.description: A sphere of shimmering force wraps a Large or smaller creature or object. An unwilling creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. Nothing gets in or out: no attacks, no spells, no gas. Creatures inside can roll the sphere at half speed. Disintegrate pops it.

spells.name: Shrivel
ranks: 10d8 necrotic damage. On a failure, the target also has disadvantage on Strength saves until the end of its next turn.
spells.description: You suck the moisture out of a creature. It makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Plants and plant creatures have disadvantage and take maximum damage. Undead and constructs are unaffected.

spells.name: Wanted Poster
spells.allowed_classes: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger, Wizard
ranks: You also learn its distance and whether it is moving.
Running water no longer blocks it. Your party can see the arrow too.
Range covers the whole floor. You learn which neighbourhood it is in.
spells.note: WANTED: Dead or alive. The System prefers dead. Higher ratings.
spells.description: You picture a creature you have seen within 30 feet, or a kind of creature. You sense the direction of the nearest such creature within 1,000 feet, if one is there.

spells.name: Crafting Table
ranks: Casting time 1 action for objects you could make in one hour.
Count as having a Workbench for one crafting check.
You can craft a common magic item if you have its recipe and materials.
spells.description: You turn raw materials into finished goods of the same material: a bridge from planks, rope from hemp, armor from scrap. Up to a 10-foot cube (or a 5-foot cube of metal or stone). You can't make magic items, and fine items need the right tool proficiency. Treat it as a Workbench crafting session in the field (see crafting).

spells.name: Storage Unit
ranks: It keeps food and parts fresh forever.
You can summon it from any floor.
It's a whole storage unit: 10-foot cube.
spells.note: Climate controlled. Monster free. Mostly.
spells.description: You hide a chest (up to 3 feet by 2 by 2) in a pocket dimension. As an action you can summon it back while holding the key. It doesn't count toward your inventory.

spells.name: Ask the System
ranks: Three yes-or-no questions instead, or learn the legends of an item, place or person.
You learn the layout of the surrounding 3 miles (terrain, water, settlements, safe rooms).
Once per floor, the System's AI answers one question about the floor's boss truthfully. It's grumpy about it.
spells.note: Your ticket has been received. Estimated response time: whenever. Thank you for crawling.
spells.description: You open a support ticket with the System and ask one question about a goal, event or activity within the next 7 days. The GM answers truthfully, in a short phrase, rhyme or omen. The System is helpful, technically. Each casting after the first before a long rest has a cumulative 25% chance of an unhelpful answer.

spells.name: Plumber's Nightmare
ranks: You can also control sewage, slime and other liquids.
Whirlpool damage 6d8, and creatures inside are Restrained.
spells.description: You control water in a 100-foot cube: raise a flood, part a channel, redirect a flow, or spin a whirlpool (creatures in it make a Strength save or take 2d8 bludgeoning and are pulled toward the center).

spells.name: Fan Club
ranks: Three creatures. Charmed fans will defend you against others.
Five creatures. A charmed fan gives you one gift (the GM decides) when the spell ends.
spells.description: Any creature becomes a fan. It makes a Wisdom saving throw, with advantage if you're fighting it. On a failure, it is Charmed by you until the spell ends or you or your allies hurt it.

spells.name: Hot Mess
ranks: 4d8 retaliation. You can switch between warm and chill as a bonus action.
spells.note: You are a hot mess. This is a compliment.
spells.description: Flames or frost wrap your body. Choose warm or chill. You have resistance to cold (warm) or fire (chill) damage. A creature that hits you with a melee attack from within 5 feet takes 2d8 fire (warm) or cold (chill) damage.

spells.name: Brain Freeze
ranks: 10d8 cold damage. Creatures that fail have their speed halved until the end of their next turn.
12d8 cold damage. Creatures that fail can't take reactions until the end of their next turn.
spells.note: Ow, ow, ow, ow. Brain freeze! The bad kind. The fatal kind.
spells.description: A blast of frozen air. Each creature in a 60-foot cone makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 cold damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A creature killed by it becomes a frozen statue.

spells.name: Sky Laser
ranks: 7d6 + 7d6. Creatures that fail are Blinded until the end of their next turn.
9d6 + 9d6. You can move the laser 30 feet as a bonus action on your next turn and hit again for half (no mana).
spells.description: An orbital laser burns down in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 5d6 fire and 5d6 radiant damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Sprinkler System
ranks: 7d8 + modifier. It also puts out fires and ends the Poisoned condition.
9d8 + modifier. Any number of creatures in the area.
spells.note: Please do not drink from the sprinklers. Actually, go ahead.
spells.description: Glowing healing water sprays over a 30-foot-radius sphere. Up to six creatures of your choice in it regain 5d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points.

spells.name: Good As New
ranks: It also regrows a lost limb over 1 minute.
spells.description: You end one of these on a creature: one Exhaustion level, the Charmed or Petrified condition, a curse, a reduction to an ability score, or a reduction to its hit point maximum.

spells.name: Pause Screen
ranks: Three creatures. Undead are no longer immune.
Five creatures. A target repeats the save only every other turn.
spells.note: PAUSED. Press start to continue.
spells.description: You press pause on a creature. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is Paralyzed until the spell ends. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Undead are immune.

spells.name: Puppet Show
spells.description: A humanoid makes a Wisdom saving throw, with advantage if you're fighting it. On a failure, it is Charmed, and you control it telepathically on the same floor. As a bonus action you can take over its whole turn. Each time it takes damage, it repeats the save.

spells.name: Invisible Wall
ranks: You can make one panel one-way.
spells.note: You cannot go that way. You've seen the cutscene. You know why.
spells.description: The kind of invisible wall that ends every video game level. It's up to ten 10-foot panels, or a dome or sphere 10 feet across. Nothing can pass through it. It is immune to all damage, and only disintegrate or factory reset (at Rank V) removes it.

spells.name: Stonewall
ranks: You can shape it into stairs, battlements or a bridge, and creatures caught in it are pushed to the side you choose.
spells.description: A wall of stone up to ten 10-foot panels, 6 inches thick, rises from the floor. Each panel has AC 15 and 30 hit points per inch of thickness. If you concentrate for the full duration, it becomes permanent.

spells.name: Yoink
ranks: You can move it as a bonus action.
You can slam a creature you are holding into a surface: 6d6 bludgeoning damage.
spells.note: Yoink!
spells.description: Telekinesis. As an action on later turns, move a creature (Strength save to resist; a contested check if you prefer) or an object up to 1,000 pounds, 30 feet in any direction. You can hold a creature Restrained in the air. You can also yank an object someone is holding (contested check).

spells.name: Livestream
ranks: One creature on the same floor.
You can also scry a place you have visited.
You can cast spells of 3rd level or lower through the sensor (only at the target).
You can scry onto another floor.
spells.note: Like and subscribe to this crawler's feed. Ignore that they're being stalked.
spells.description: You tune into someone's feed. A creature on the same floor makes a Wisdom saving throw, modified by how well you know it (−5 if you know it well, +5 if barely). On a failure, you see and hear it through an invisible sensor next to it.

spells.name: Ctrl+Z
spells.description: You undo someone's memories. A creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is Charmed for the duration, and you can erase or change its memory of an event in the last 24 hours.

spells.name: Murder Hornets
ranks: 6d10 piercing damage. You can move the swarm 20 feet as a bonus action.
spells.description: A swarm of murder hornets fills a 20-foot-radius sphere. It is Lightly Obscured and Difficult Terrain. A creature that enters it or starts its turn there makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d10 piercing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Toxic Waste
ranks: 7d8 poison damage. You choose its direction each turn (or keep it still).
9d8 poison damage. Resistance to poison doesn't apply.
spells.description: A glowing green fog fills a 20-foot-radius sphere and drifts 10 feet away from you each turn. Each creature in it when it appears, or that enters it or ends its turn there, makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d8 poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Body Slam
ranks: 7d6 + 5d6. Creatures that fail can't take reactions until the start of your next turn.
spells.note: From the top rope! OH MY GOD! OH MY GOD!
spells.description: You leap and slam into the floor. Each creature you choose within 30 feet makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 5d6 thunder and 5d6 radiant or necrotic damage and falls Prone. On a success, it takes half as much and doesn't fall.

spells.name: Costume Party
ranks: Disadvantage on the check to see through it.
spells.description: Any number of creatures you can see get illusory costumes of your choice. An unwilling one makes a Charisma saving throw. A creature can see through it with an Investigation check against your spell save DC.

spells.name: Terms of Service
spells.allowed_classes: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Warlock, Wizard
ranks: 180 days. It also works on a creature you summoned: it serves you for the duration.
spells.note: By continuing to exist, you agree to these Terms of Service.
spells.description: A creature that can understand you must agree to the terms. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is Charmed and must follow a command you give, or do or not do something. Each day it acts against the terms, it takes 5d10 psychic damage (once a day).

spells.name: Haunted Furniture
ranks: Fourteen objects. Their slam attacks deal an extra 1d4 damage.
spells.note: The ottoman has chosen violence.
spells.description: Up to ten nonmagical objects come to life and fight for you: chairs, vending machines, lamps. Use the Animated Object stat block from the 2024 Player's Handbook. As a bonus action, command any of them within 500 feet.

spells.name: 3D Printer
ranks: One object a day is permanent.
spells.description: You print a nonliving object of vegetable matter, stone, crystal or metal, up to a 5-foot cube. It lasts 1 day for vegetable matter, 12 hours for stone or crystal, 1 hour for metal. Using it as a crafting material (see crafting) makes the crafted item vanish when it does.

spells.name: Personal Space
ranks: Undead and constructs are kept out too.
Creatures pushed out by the spell take 4d6 force damage.
You can let creatures you choose in.
Moving into a creature no longer ends it; you push it ahead of you.
spells.description: Living creatures other than you can't move into the 10-foot area around you or reach through it. If you move into one, the spell ends.

spells.name: Tree Hopper
ranks: Any distance on the same floor, and you can bring up to eight willing creatures with you.
You can make a plant a door: it stays open for a round for anyone to use.
spells.description: Once on each of your turns, you can step into a living plant (or a big fungus) and come out of another one within 500 feet. It costs 5 feet of movement.

spells.name: Character Creator
ranks: Roll twice and the target picks.
The target picks any race on the Floor 3 menu.
It gains 1 Stat Point from the experience.
spells.note: Welcome back! We've updated your appearance. No refunds.
spells.description: You touch a dead humanoid (dead up to 10 days). It returns in a new adult body. Roll a race on a d10 (the GM's table) or the System picks. It keeps its class, Crawler Skills and memories.

spells.name: Home Turf
ranks: Allies in it regain hit points equal to your level when they finish a short rest.
It counts as a safe room for a long rest (the System considers this "a loophole").
spells.description: You claim an area up to 60 feet in radius. Celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead can't enter it. You add one extra effect: courage (no Frightened), darkness or daylight, peaceful rest, or vulnerability for a creature type.

spells.name: Combo Breaker
spells.note: C-C-C-COMBO BREAKER!
spells.description: You blur into a combo. Choose up to five creatures in range and make a melee spell attack against each. On a hit, it takes 6d10 force damage. Then teleport to a space within 5 feet of one of them.

spells.name: Continue?
ranks: 30 days. Returns with half its hit points.
spells.description: A countdown appears over a creature that has been dead no longer than 10 days. It returns to life with 1 hit point. It has a −4 penalty to d20 tests that drops by 1 each long rest.

spells.name: Dream Hack
ranks: You can bring one ally into the dream.
You can reach a creature on another floor.
A nightmare also gives it one Exhaustion level.
spells.description: You enter the dreams of a creature you know on the same floor, and talk to it. You can make it a nightmare: it makes a Wisdom saving throw, and on a failure it gains no benefit from its rest and takes 3d6 psychic damage when it wakes.

spells.name: Main Character Energy
ranks: 8d6 psychic damage. Allies in the area have advantage on Charisma checks.
spells.note: It's not arrogance if the camera's on you.
spells.description: Everyone knows who the main character is. Each creature of your choice that starts its turn within 10 feet of you makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes 4d6 psychic damage and falls Prone, or is pushed 10 feet away (your choice).

spells.name: Portal
ranks: Casting time 1 action. Instead you can make two linked portals within 500 feet of each other that last for concentration, up to 10 minutes.
You can link it to a stairwell you have found, even across the whole floor.
spells.note: Portals cannot take you to another floor. Stop asking. The stairs are RIGHT THERE.
spells.description: You draw a glowing portal that links to a place you have been on the same floor. Anyone who steps in arrives there. It stays open until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Daisy Chain
ranks: Six targets. Creatures that fail can't take reactions until the start of their next turn.
spells.description: Lightning hits one target, then jumps to up to three others within 30 feet of it. Each makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d8 lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Delete
ranks: 16d6 + 40 force. On a success, it still takes 5d6 force.
spells.note: Are you sure you want to delete this crawler? Too late.
spells.description: A thin green ray. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 10d6 + 40 force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points is deleted: it and everything it wears or carries, except magic items, turns to dust. The ray also deletes a Large object or a 10-foot cube of a wall, and any wall of force.

spells.name: Medic!
ranks: 90 hit points. Two creatures share the healing however you like.
120 hit points. You can cast it as a bonus action.
spells.description: A creature regains 70 hit points and is cured of the Blinded, Deafened and Poisoned conditions.

spells.name: Nerf
ranks: 16d6 necrotic. On a failure it also has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
18d6 necrotic, and it can drop the target to 0.
spells.note: Patch notes: you.
spells.description: A creature gets nerfed. It makes a Constitution saving throw. It takes 14d6 necrotic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success, and its hit point maximum drops by the damage on a failure until it finishes a long rest. The spell can't drop it below 1 hit point.

spells.name: Invuln Frames
ranks: Blocks spells of 5th level or lower.
spells.description: A flickering dome surrounds you. Spells of 5th level or lower cast from outside can't affect anything inside, even cast at a higher level.

spells.name: Viral Video
ranks: Sixteen creatures. They think it was their own idea.
1 year, and any number of creatures in range.
spells.note: It's trending!
spells.description: You suggest a course of action to up to twelve creatures. Each makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it follows the suggestion as well as it can.

spells.name: Admin View
ranks: It also sees traps and every creature's current hit points as a percentage bar.
It sees through walls up to 5 feet thick.
spells.description: A creature sees the dungeon the way the admins do: Truesight out to 120 feet. It sees through illusions, sees Invisible creatures, sees shapechangers' true forms, sees secret doors, and sees into the Ethereal Plane.

spells.name: Solar Flare
ranks: 8d8 radiant. You can fire it as a bonus action.
10d8 radiant. Undead and oozes have disadvantage.
spells.description: A beam of sunlight blazes from your hand in a line 60 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 6d8 radiant damage and is Blinded until the start of your next turn. On a success, it takes half damage. As an action on later turns, fire the beam again.

spells.name: Wipe
ranks: 12d8 necrotic. You choose which creatures are affected.
spells.note: Party wipe! Better luck next floor.
spells.description: A sphere of negative energy erupts with a 60-foot radius. Each creature in it makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Deep Freeze
ranks: 12d6 cold. Or instead, a wall of ice up to ten 10-foot panels that lasts concentration, up to 10 minutes.
14d6 cold. Creatures that fail are Restrained in ice until the end of their next turn.
spells.description: A ball of frost explodes in a 60-foot radius. Each creature makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d6 cold damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Water in the area freezes 6 inches deep for 1 minute.

spells.name: All-You-Can-Eat Buffet
ranks: Twenty diners. The bowl isn't consumed.
spells.note: All you can eat! Terms and conditions apply. Do not eat the sneeze guard.
spells.description: A buffet appears. Up to twelve creatures can eat over 1 hour. Each one is cured of all poison and disease, becomes immune to poison and the Frightened condition, has advantage on Wisdom saves, and gains 2d10 to its hit point maximum and current hit points, for 24 hours.
spells.comp_m_text: a gem-encrusted bowl worth 1,000 gp, consumed

spells.name: Stink Eye
ranks: You can use it as a bonus action.
Sickened targets also take 4d6 poison damage.
spells.description: Your eyes go pitch black. On each of your turns, as an action, choose a creature within 60 feet that can see you. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, choose: Asleep (Unconscious until damaged or shaken), Panicked (Frightened, Dashes away) or Sickened (Poisoned, disadvantage on attacks and checks).

spells.name: Blender
ranks: 8d10 slashing. Allies you choose pass through unharmed.
spells.description: A wall of whirling blades up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high and 5 feet thick, or a ring 60 feet across. It gives three-quarters cover. A creature that enters it or starts its turn there makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d10 slashing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Hearthstone
ranks: Six creatures, a safe room on this floor.
Or to a stairwell you've found on this floor.
Once per floor, it can take you to the stairwell even if you haven't found it.
spells.note: Your hearthstone is on cooldown.
spells.description: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet teleport to a safe room you have rested in on this floor. You choose it when you cast.

spells.name: The Finger
ranks: 9d8 + 30. Any creature killed by it rises as a zombie.
spells.note: The System would like to apologize to viewers for the gesture. The System is not sorry.
spells.description: You give a creature the finger. It makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A humanoid killed by it rises at the start of your next turn as a zombie that obeys you.

spells.name: Hellscape
ranks: 11d10 fire. Resistance to fire doesn't apply.
spells.description: Sheets of fire fill up to ten 10-foot cubes. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d10 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Fast Travel
ranks: No mishaps for places you've visited.
You can fast travel to any stairwell on this floor, found or not.
spells.note: Fast travel is unavailable while enemies are nearby. Just kidding. Go nuts.
spells.description: You and up to eight willing creatures teleport to a place on the same floor. Places you know well are safe. Places you've only heard of risk a mishap (the GM rolls).

spells.name: Server Transfer
ranks: Ethereal travel lasts 8 hours, and you can return to any point on the floor.
The banished target has disadvantage on the save.
Once per floor, you can reach a hidden area or secret level on this floor.
spells.description: You and up to eight willing creatures shift to the Ethereal Plane or a pocket plane the floor allows. The World Dungeon blocks travel off the floor: you can't leave the floor this way unless the GM says so. Or you can banish one creature (melee spell attack, then a Charisma save).

spells.name: Health Regen
spells.description: A creature regains 4d8 + 15 hit points, then 1 hit point at the start of each of its turns for the duration. Lost limbs regrow over 2 minutes.

spells.name: Back From the Dead
ranks: No penalty to d20 tests afterwards.
The System gives the creature a "Back From the Dead" Bronze box.
spells.description: A creature dead no longer than a century returns to life with all its hit points. Missing body parts are restored.

spells.name: Upside Down
ranks: You can flip it back and forth as an action.
You choose which creatures are affected.
Creatures that fail can't grab on: no save.
spells.description: Gravity flips in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder. Everything not anchored falls up. A creature can make a Dexterity save to grab something. Creatures hitting the ceiling take falling damage.

spells.name: RGB Lighting
ranks: 14d6 damage. You can reroll one creature's color.
16d6 damage. You choose the color for one creature.
spells.note: Now with 16.7 million colors. Most of them hurt.
spells.description: A gamer's rainbow blasts out in a 60-foot cone. Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 12d6 damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Roll a d8 per creature for the color: 1 fire, 2 acid, 3 lightning, 4 poison, 5 cold, 6 Restrained then Petrified (Constitution saves), 7 Blinded, 8 roll twice.

spells.name: Timeout Box
spells.note: Go sit in the corner and think about what you did.
spells.description: An invisible box of force traps everything in a 10-foot cube (or a 20-foot cage of bars). A creature trying to teleport out makes a Charisma saving throw, and on a failure can't leave and wastes the spell.

spells.name: Body Double
ranks: It can regain hit points from repairs in a workbench (100 gp per hit point).
It has half the creature's mana and regains it on a long rest.
spells.description: You make a snowy duplicate of a creature. It has half the creature's hit points, its stats and abilities, but can't regain spell uses or mana and can't level up. It obeys you. Casting it again destroys the old one.

spells.name: Mic Drop
spells.note: Mic drop.
spells.description: You say one perfect last word and drop the mic. Each creature you choose makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, based on its current hit points: 50 or fewer, Deafened; 40 or fewer, also Blinded; 30 or fewer, also Stunned; 20 or fewer, it dies. Celestials, elementals, fey and fiends that fail are also sent back home.

spells.name: Supernova
ranks: 14d6 radiant. You choose creatures to spare.
16d6 radiant. Undead that fail are destroyed if their CR is 5 or lower.
spells.description: Sunlight explodes in a 60-foot radius. Each creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 12d6 radiant damage and is Blinded for 1 minute (save at the end of each turn). On a success, it takes half damage.

spells.name: Seismic Event
ranks: Creatures that fall Prone also take 5d6 bludgeoning damage.
spells.description: The floor shakes in a 100-foot radius. It is Difficult Terrain. Concentration breaks on a failed Constitution save. Creatures on the ground make a Dexterity save or fall Prone. Fissures open and structures take 50 damage each round. The System warns you: the floor doesn't collapse, but everything on it might.

spells.name: Brain Rot
ranks: 12d12 psychic. It repeats the save only every 60 days.
spells.note: Skibidi.
spells.description: You show a creature fifteen hours of short-form video at once. It makes an Intelligence saving throw. It takes 10d12 psychic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. On a failure, it also can't cast spells or take the Magic action, and has disadvantage on Intelligence and Charisma checks. It repeats the save every 30 days.

spells.name: Blue Screen
spells.note: A fatal exception has occurred. Press any key to die.
spells.description: A creature with 150 hit points or fewer crashes: it is Stunned. It makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. A creature with more hit points has its speed reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn instead.

spells.name: Possession
ranks: It repeats the save only when it takes 20 or more damage at once.
spells.description: Any creature makes a Wisdom saving throw, with advantage if you're fighting it. On a failure, it is Charmed, and you control it telepathically on the same floor. As a bonus action you can take its whole turn. It repeats the save when it takes damage.

spells.name: Dead Zone
ranks: Your own magic items keep working.
You choose allies whose spells still work.
spells.description: No signal. Magic doesn't work within 10 feet of you: spells, magic items, magical attacks, summons, teleporting. The Interface still works, mostly.

spells.name: Halo Effect
ranks: Allies regain 2d6 hit points at the start of each of their turns.
spells.description: Halos appear over your allies within 30 feet. They have advantage on saving throws, and attacks against them have disadvantage. A fiend or undead that hits one with a melee attack makes a Constitution save or is Blinded.

spells.name: Smokestack
ranks: 12d8 fire. You steer it each turn.
spells.description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of burning smoke drifts 10 feet a turn. It is Heavily Obscured. A creature that enters it or starts its turn there makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d8 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Side Quest
ranks: DC 24. It takes 4d6 psychic damage each failed check.
DC 28. It makes the check with disadvantage.
spells.note: New side quest: Escape the Maze. Reward: not being in a maze.
spells.description: You send a creature on a side quest: it vanishes into a labyrinth pocket dimension. As an action it can make a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check to escape. Minotaurs and goristros escape automatically.

spells.name: Incognito Mode
spells.description: A creature is immune to psychic damage, the Charmed condition, and anything that would read its mind, detect its feelings or divine its location, including wish.

spells.name: Sky Is Falling
ranks: Seven meteors. Structures in the areas are destroyed.
spells.note: The sky is falling! No really, look up.
spells.description: Four flaming meteors smash into points you choose. Each creature in a 40-foot radius of each point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 20d6 fire and 20d6 bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A creature in more than one blast is affected only once.

spells.name: Feature Request
ranks: No necrotic damage after a request.
The System grants one request per floor without any risk. It will interpret it very literally.
spells.note: Your feature request has been received and will be considered. It will not be considered.
spells.description: You submit a feature request to the System. Cast any spell of 8th level or lower without paying for it or meeting its requirements. Or ask for anything else, and the GM decides how the System grants it. After any request that isn't casting a spell, you take 1d10 necrotic damage each time you cast a spell until you finish a long rest, and there is a 33% chance you can never cast this spell again.

spells.name: Pause Menu
ranks: You can affect one creature and the spell doesn't end (its next turn is lost).
spells.description: You hit pause on everyone else. You take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row. The spell ends if anything you do affects another creature or something it wears or carries, or if you move more than 1,000 feet from where you cast it.

spells.name: Unalive
spells.note: Please use the approved term.
spells.description: A creature with 100 hit points or fewer dies. A creature with more takes 12d12 psychic damage.

spells.name: Full Party Heal
ranks: 900. Creatures you heal from 0 hit points also stand up.
spells.description: You restore up to 700 hit points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures. They are also cured of all diseases and the Blinded, Deafened and Poisoned conditions.

spells.name: New Game Plus
ranks: The creature keeps one achievement box it hadn't opened.
spells.description: A creature dead no longer than 200 years returns to life in perfect health, in a new body if needed. You only need its name.

spells.name: Boss Door
ranks: The creature is Charmed by you for 1 minute when it arrives (no save).
You can open it to any spot on this floor.
You can open it to the stairwell of the next floor. The System is not happy.
spells.description: You open a huge boss door to another place. Most floors block travel to other planes. You can still call a specific creature through by name: it is pulled to you (not under your control).

spells.name: Spoilers
spells.note: Spoiler alert: you're going to need this.
spells.description: A willing creature knows what's coming. It can't be surprised and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws. Others have disadvantage on attack rolls against it.

spells.name: Weather Event
ranks: You choose the order of the effects.
spells.description: A storm cloud 300 feet across fills the ceiling. On each of your turns, it does something new: thunder (2d6 thunder, Deafened), acid rain (4d6 acid), lightning (six bolts of 10d6 lightning), hail (2d6 bludgeoning), and freezing wind (Difficult Terrain, ranged attacks impossible).

spells.name: Full Rebrand
ranks: The new form keeps the target's hit points if they are higher.
spells.description: Turn a creature into another creature, a creature into an object, or an object into a creature. An unwilling creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. If you concentrate for the full hour, it lasts until dispelled. Or you can shapechange yourself into creatures of CR up to your level as often as you like for the duration.

spells.name: Scream Into the Void
ranks: 18d6. Any number of creatures in range.
spells.note: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA. Thank you. We feel better too.
spells.description: You scream your frustration with the entire World Dungeon at up to ten creatures. Each makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, it takes 14d6 psychic damage and is Stunned (save at the end of each turn). On a success, half damage. A creature killed by it has its head explode.

Barbarian.scaling: Rage damage +1 per 2 prestige levels. One extra Rage per long rest every 4 prestige levels.

features.name: Endless Rage
features.text: Your Rage only ends early if you choose. When you start raging, gain temporary hit points equal to your Barbarian level.

features.name: Titan's Grip
features.text: You can wield a two-handed weapon in one hand. Your heavy weapons' damage dice increase by one size.

features.name: Unstoppable
features.text: While raging, you cannot be charmed, frightened or stunned.

features.name: Earthshaker
features.text: Once per turn, when you hit while raging, creatures of your choice within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a Strength save or fall prone.

features.name: Avatar of Wrath
features.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute: you become Huge, your reach increases by 5 feet, you have resistance to all damage, and your weapon hits deal +2d12 damage.

Bard.scaling: Your Bardic Inspiration die gains +1 to its result per 2 prestige levels.

features.name: Encore
features.text: When a creature succeeds on a roll using your Bardic Inspiration, you regain that use.

features.name: Standing Ovation
features.text: When you roll initiative, every ally within 30 feet gains one of your Bardic Inspiration dice for free. Once per session, gain +2 Audience points.

features.name: Showstopper
features.text: Once per short rest, cast a bard spell of 5th level or lower without spending mana.

features.name: Magnum Opus
features.text: Learn two spells from any class's spell list, of any level you can cast. They count as bard spells.

features.name: Final Act
features.text: Once per long rest, as an action: every ally within 60 feet regains all its hit points, ends all conditions on itself, and has advantage on all rolls until the end of its next turn.

Cleric.scaling: One extra use of Channel Divinity per long rest every 4 prestige levels.

features.name: Chosen
features.text: Once per long rest, your Divine Intervention automatically works.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.text: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage and healing rolls of your cleric spells.

features.name: Sanctified Ground
features.text: Once per long rest, as an action, bless a 30-foot radius for 1 minute. Allies there regain 2 × PB hit points at the start of each of their turns; undead and fiends there have disadvantage on attacks.

features.name: Miracle Worker
features.text: Once per long rest, cast a cleric spell of 7th level or lower without spending mana.

features.name: Hand of God
features.text: Once per long rest, when an ally within 60 feet would die, it instead regains all its hit points.

Druid.scaling: One extra use of Wild Shape per long rest every 4 prestige levels.

features.name: Nature's Arsenal
features.text: While in Wild Shape, your natural attacks count as magical, use your Wisdom modifier for attack rolls if it is higher, and deal extra damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Living Fortress
features.text: When you Wild Shape, gain temporary hit points equal to 3 × your Druid level.

features.name: Many Shapes
features.text: You can Wild Shape into monstrosities and plants, not only beasts, using your normal Wild Shape CR limit. An owlbear is now on the menu.

features.name: Verdant Rebirth
features.text: Once per long rest, when you drop to 0 hit points, you instead return to half your hit points in a burst of flowers.

features.name: Avatar of the Wild
features.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute: Wild Shape into any beast, monstrosity or dragon of CR 10 or lower (GM approves the stat block). You keep your spellcasting.

Fighter.scaling: One extra Action Surge per short rest every 4 prestige levels.

features.name: Weapon Master
features.text: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 (or one lower than your current range, if it is already wider).

features.name: Relentless
features.text: When you roll initiative with no Action Surge left, you regain one use.

features.name: Extra Extra Attack
features.text: You make one more attack whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Indomitable Will
features.text: You gain two more uses of Indomitable. When you succeed on a save with it, you have advantage on your next attack roll.

features.name: Living Legend
features.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute: once per turn, you can turn a missed attack into a hit.

Monk.scaling: Your Martial Arts damage gains +1 per 2 prestige levels. You gain 2 extra Focus (ki) points per prestige level.

features.name: Endless Flow
features.text: At the start of each of your turns, if you have no Focus points, regain 1.

features.name: Hundred Fists
features.text: Flurry of Blows makes four unarmed strikes instead of two.

features.name: Perfect Body
features.text: You are immune to disease, poison and exhaustion, and you no longer need food or water.

features.name: Pressure Points
features.text: Once per turn, you can use Stunning Strike without spending Focus.

features.name: Ascended Master
features.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute: your speed doubles, your unarmed strikes deal +2d10 force damage, and you do not provoke opportunity attacks.

Paladin.scaling: Your auras' range increases by 10 feet every 4 prestige levels.

features.name: Blessed Smite
features.text: Your Divine Smite deals +1d8 radiant damage.

features.name: Bulwark Aura
features.text: At dawn, choose a damage type. Allies in your aura have resistance to it.

features.name: Holy Champion
features.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute: you sprout wings (fly 60 feet), your weapon hits deal +2d8 radiant damage, and allies in your aura regain 10 hit points at the start of their turns.

features.name: Oathkeeper
features.text: When an ally in your aura takes damage, you can use your reaction to take it instead, with resistance.

features.name: Final Judgment
features.text: Once per long rest, when you hit with a melee attack, the target must succeed on a Constitution save or drop to 0 hit points. On a success, it takes 10d10 radiant damage. Gods are immune.

Ranger.scaling: Your Hunter's Mark (or favored-enemy) damage gains +1d4 every 4 prestige levels.

features.name: Apex Hunter
features.text: Hunter's Mark costs no mana and does not need concentration.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.text: Your pet or companion makes two attacks when commanded to attack.

features.name: Ghost of the Wilds
features.text: While you are lightly or heavily obscured and have not attacked this turn, you are invisible.

features.name: Volley
features.text: When you take the Attack action with a ranged weapon, you can instead make one attack against every creature of your choice within a 10-foot radius you can see.

features.name: Death Sentence
features.text: Once per long rest, mark a creature you can see. For 24 hours, all your hits against it are critical hits.

features.name: Twice Sneaky
features.text: You can deal Sneak Attack damage twice per round: once on your turn, and once on another creature's turn.

features.name: Untouchable
features.text: You can use Uncanny Dodge twice per round (the second costs no reaction).

features.name: Master Thief
features.text: Cunning Action also lets you pick a lock, disarm a trap, make a Sleight of Hand check, or use an object.

features.name: Shadowstep
features.text: As a bonus action, teleport up to 60 feet from one area of dim light or darkness to another.

features.name: Stroke of Fate
features.text: Once per short rest, turn a missed attack into a hit, or a failed ability check into a 20.

features.name: Overchannel
features.text: Once per long rest, when you cast a sorcerer spell that deals damage, it deals maximum damage.

features.name: Metamagic Master
features.text: Learn two more Metamagic options. You can apply two Metamagic options to one spell.

features.name: Wellspring
features.text: When you roll initiative with fewer than half your sorcery points, regain 4 sorcery points.

features.name: Living Spell
features.text: Once per long rest, cast a sorcerer spell of 8th level or lower without spending mana.

features.name: Unbound
features.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute, your spells cost no mana. The once-per-long-rest limit on 6th–9th level spells still applies.

Warlock.scaling: +7 Pact Mana per prestige level (see Mana).

features.name: Patron's Favor
features.text: Gain one more Mystic Arcanum, of any level from 6th to 9th that you do not already have.

features.name: Invocation Master
features.text: Learn two more Eldritch Invocations.

features.name: Pact Surge
features.text: Your pact level becomes 6th. Spells cast with Pact Mana are cast at 6th level and cost 9 Pact Mana.

features.name: Patron's Avatar
features.text: Once per long rest, summon an avatar of your patron for 1 minute. It uses a stat block of CR up to half your Warlock level, chosen with the GM, and obeys you.

features.name: Dark Bargain
features.text: Once per long rest, ask your patron for anything (as the wish spell). Your patron will name a price.

Wizard.scaling: Learn 1 extra wizard spell as a tome spell each prestige level. Arcane Recovery restores 1 more spell level every 2 prestige levels.

features.name: Spell Mastery+
features.text: Choose a 3rd-level wizard spell in your tome. You can cast it at its lowest level without spending mana.

features.name: Arcane Library
features.text: When you read a tome holding a wizard spell, the spell gains 1 extra rank.

features.name: Archmage
features.text: Once per short rest, cast a wizard spell of 5th level or lower without spending mana.

features.name: Twin Thought
features.text: Once per long rest, cast two spells with one action. Pay mana for both, and only one can need concentration.

features.name: Rewrite Reality
features.text: Once per long rest, cast wish without spending mana and without its stress.
